title: Full-Stack Developer – API Integrations & Marketing Dashboards
description:
About the Role



We are an Australian digital marketing agency looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build an internal, automated client reporting platform.



We currently use several SEO and analytics platforms and want to consolidate data from multiple sources into one central, branded client dashboard.



This is not a WordPress development role and is not a standard Looker Studio reporting role.



We need someone experienced with APIs, databases, authentication and modern web applications.



What You Will Build



You will build a multi-client reporting platform that allows our internal team and clients to securely log in and view marketing and SEO performance.



The platform needs to be scalable so new clients can be added without building a new dashboard each time.



Proposed technology stack:



• Next.js / React

• Supabase

• Vercel

• Third-party SEO APIs

• Google Search Console API

• Google Analytics 4 Data API

• Claude / Claude API where appropriate

• GitHub



We are open to recommendations on the architecture.



Core Responsibilities



• Build the reporting web application

• Integrate multiple third-party marketing and SEO APIs

• Integrate Google Search Console and GA4

• Build automated daily data syncing

• Store historical performance data

• Create a scalable multi-client database structure

• Build secure client authentication

• Ensure clients can only access their own data

• Build an admin area for adding and managing clients

• Create clean, responsive reporting dashboards

• Deploy the application through Vercel

• Configure Supabase database and authentication

• Maintain clean, documented code through GitHub

• Implement API error handling, logging and retry processes



Dashboard Reporting



The platform will include reporting such as:



• Organic traffic

• Organic conversions / leads

• Search clicks and impressions

• CTR and average position

• Keyword rankings

• Keyword movements

• Top 3, Top 10 and Top 20 rankings

• Biggest ranking improvements and declines

• Landing-page performance

• SEO visibility

• Competitor performance

• Backlinks

• Technical SEO / site health

• Month-on-month comparisons

• Custom date-range comparisons



We also want to explore AI-generated reporting commentary that automatically analyses client performance and produces short, plain-English summaries.



What We're Looking For



Strong experience with:



• JavaScript / TypeScript

• React

• Next.js

• REST APIs

• OAuth / Google authentication

• Supabase or PostgreSQL

• Database architecture

• Vercel

• GitHub

• Cron jobs / scheduled processes

• API error handling

• Secure credential management



Experience working with marketing, analytics or SEO APIs is highly regarded.



Experience using Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI development tools is also beneficial.



You do not need to be an SEO specialist.



However, you must understand how to retrieve data from multiple APIs, normalise and store that data correctly, and present it through a reliable web application.



Important



We are not looking for someone to simply embed existing reporting dashboards.



We want to own the underlying platform, source code and data infrastructure.



All development will take place within accounts and infrastructure controlled by us.



First Milestone



The first milestone will be a working proof of concept using ONE client account.



The proof of concept should:



1. Connect to the required SEO data sources.

2. Connect to Google Search Console.

3. Connect to GA4.

4. Automatically retrieve reporting data.

5. Store historical data.

6. Display the information through a working dashboard.

7. Automatically refresh the data.

8. Handle API failures without breaking the dashboard.



Once the proof of concept is working correctly, the project will move into the multi-client build.



When Applying



Please provide:



• Examples of API-driven dashboards or SaaS applications you have built

• Experience working with Google APIs

• Experience with Next.js, Supabase and Vercel

• Experience integrating third-party REST APIs

• Whether you use Claude Code, Cursor or another AI coding environment

• Your hourly rate in USD

• Your weekly availability



Please also answer this question:



“If you were building a multi-client dashboard pulling data from several different APIs every day, how would you structure the data syncing and database so an API failure does not break the client dashboard?”



Please do not send only generic WordPress website examples. We are specifically looking for someone with API integration and application development experience.

title: Customer Service Manager – DTC Supplement Brand US
description:
About us



We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer health and supplements company selling into the US market on a subscription model. Our brands are built around clean formulations, strong educational content, and long-term customer relationships. We're profitable, we're scaling, and we're building a team of A-players who take real ownership of their function.



This role is a big one. Customer experience is one of the biggest levers we have as we grow, and the person we hire will shape how thousands of customers experience our brands every day.



The role



You will run the day-to-day of our customer service operation. That means managing our support agents, keeping response times and quality where they should be, and taking real ownership of retention, churn, and disputes. You are not just a ticket queue manager. You are the person who understands why customers cancel, why disputes happen, what refund patterns are telling us, and how to build systems that keep subscribers happy and paying.



What you'll own



- Manage a team of support agents across
, chat, and social DMs. Set schedules, review performance, and coach on tone and problem-solving.



- Monitor daily support KPIs: first response time, resolution time, CSAT, ticket backlog, save rate on cancellations, and refund rate.



- Own the dispute rate. Keep it well below processor thresholds, analyze root causes (unclear billing, delivery issues, subscription confusion, buyer's remorse), and build proactive systems to bring it down.



- Run regular ticket QA. Audit conversations, flag issues, and turn recurring problems into training material or macro updates.



- Own the subscription platform (Recharge, Loop, Seal, or similar). Manage cancellation flows, pause options, swap flows, dunning, and failed payment recovery.



- Track and reduce churn. Analyze cancellation reasons, propose retention offers, build win-back sequences with the marketing team, and measure the impact.



- Handle escalations personally. Difficult customers, negative reviews, BBB complaints, and anything that could turn into a bigger issue.



- Manage chargebacks end to end. Work with Shopify Payments to submit strong evidence, track win rates, and reduce dispute volume at the source.



- Coordinate with the 3PL and fulfillment partners on shipping delays, lost packages, and damaged orders. Make sure customer-facing communication is clear and fast.



- Maintain and expand the internal knowledge base and SOPs so agents can handle 90% of tickets without escalation.

Report weekly to leadership with numbers, insights, and recommendations.



What we're looking for



1+ years managing a customer service team, ideally in DTC ecommerce.



Direct experience with a subscription business model. You know terms like churn rate, LTV, MRR, involuntary churn, and save rate without needing to Google them.



Experience actively managing and lowering dispute and chargeback rates.



Hands-on experience with a helpdesk tool (Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze, Freshdesk, or similar) and a subscription platform (Recharge, Loop, Seal, Bold, etc.).



Strong written English. Native or near-native level.



Comfortable reading data. You can pull a report, spot the trend, and act on it.



Calm under pressure. Angry customers, agent mistakes, and platform outages don't rattle you.



Systems thinker. When you see the same problem three times, your instinct is to build a process, not answer the ticket a fourth time.



Nice to have



Experience in supplements, health, wellness, or beauty verticals.



Disputifier experience.



Loop experience.



Basic Shopify knowledge (order management, refunds, tags).



Why you'll love working with us



Real ownership. You'll run a critical function, not sit inside a bureaucracy. Your decisions will directly move numbers you can see.



A team that ships. We move fast, we test everything, and we don't drown in meetings. If you have a good idea on Monday, it can be live by Wednesday.



Growth without the ceiling. We're scaling into new brands and markets, and this role grows with the business. Build the CS team under you as we expand.



Fully remote and flexible. Work from wherever you're most productive.



Competitive salary based on experience, with room to grow as you deliver.



A profitable, healthy business. No VC pressure, no runway anxiety, just a company that's built to last.



How to apply



Send your CV and a short note covering:



A business you managed CS for, and what the churn and dispute rates looked like when you started vs. when you left.

One specific retention, churn, or dispute-reduction initiative you ran, with numbers.

Your notice period and earliest start date.



Please start your application with the word "Customer" at the top of your message. This helps us know you've read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



We read every application personally and reply within 2 days.

title: Acquisitions Specialist — Outreach, Negotiation & Deal Closing
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS, WHOLESALING, OR DEAL-CLOSING — READ THIS

This is the same work you already do, just a different asset. If you've sourced off-market properties, cold-called owners who weren't listed, negotiated a price, and closed the transfer — you have exactly the skill set we need. Swap "distressed property" for "online community" and the job is identical: find the owner, figure out what it's worth, reach out, and close.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities. We're hiring a sharp closer to acquire them for us. The assets are Reddit communities — but we'll teach you the platform mechanics. What we can't teach is deal instinct and judgment, and that's what we're actually hiring for.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Start from a list of candidate communities our software pulls for you, and d
 which are worth going after

• Size up each one's real worth — the right niche, genuine demand, real commercial upside — not just the headline numbers

• Track down the owner and reach them across the right channels (often their public social profiles) to open a conversation

• Negotiate and close the deal — either moderation rights or a full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are agreed

• Keep a tidy pipeline of targets, conversations, deals, and spend



WHAT MATTERS MOST (in this order)

1. Judgment — anyone can read a traffic stat. The rare skill is knowing whether a community is actually worth paying for, and how much, without us in the room for every call.

2. Closing — cold-reaching a stranger, warming them up, negotiating, and getting the deal done. This is the bulk of the work.



Reddit experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — the platform side is quick to pick up. If you're a strong closer who's never touched Reddit, still apply.



WHO YOU LIKELY ARE

• A real estate acquisitions / disposition VA, wholesaler, cold caller, domain or website flipper, or anyone who sources and closes deals for a living

• You can size up an asset's value fast and be right

• You're comfortable reaching out to strangers and closing them

• You run your own pipeline with little oversight

• Clear written English

• Nice-to-have: Reddit, affiliate, or SEO background



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every deal you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Walk me through one deal you sourced and closed yourself — a property, domain, website, whatever. How'd you find it, how'd you d
 what it was worth, and how'd you close it?

2. When you size up an online asset, what actually tells you it's worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. You need to acquire something from an owner who isn't trying to sell. How do you reach them and open the negotiation?

4. Your desired rate or salary.

title: Inbound Sales & Client Services Representative
description:
Inbound Sales & Support Representative



ABOUT US

--------------------

We are an e-commerce business specializing in hydroponic equipment serving North America. We are a small, dynamic team looking for a long-term partner who will become the primary customer representative of the company.



ABOUT THE ROLE

--------------------

We're hiring a remote dedicated Inbound Sales & Support Representative to own the front line of our customer experience.



As a key member, you'll have the opportunity to work remotely while directly shaping the success of our valued customers.



You'll answer calls, chats,
s, walk customers through our products, and close sales — while qualifying larger commercial leads for handoff to our sales manager.





Hours: 8am to 1pm PST



WHAT YOU'LL DO

--------------------

Answer inbound calls promptly — pick up live calls within a few rings or less.

Resolve routine retail support — shipment tracking, parts questions, order status, and general customer inquiries, start to finish.

Re-engage abandoned-cart shoppers and follow up on stalled quotes through outbound and cold calling.

Walk customers through our product lineup with clarity, confidence, and accurate detail

Work through objections, pricing pushback, and follow-ups without losing momentum, while staying alert to upsell and cross-sell openings.

Qualify incoming commercial inquiries — run a short intake call to understand scope and need, then hand off pre-qualified leads to our sales manager with clear notes.

Own the queue during scheduled leadership absences — during planned coverage windows, you're the single point of contact for all customer communications. High-value orders and urgent escalations get flagged for a same-day leadership review; everything else you handle directly.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

--------------------

Callers consistently reach a real person quickly — no missed calls, no long holds.

Retail issues get resolved on first contact whenever possible.

100% of leads are entered into the CRM, ready and pre-qualified for the sales manager.

Leadership can step away (including multi-day stretches) without customer experience slipping.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

--------------------

Experience in customer support, inside sales, or sales development — retail, e-commerce, or B2B distribution background is a plus.

Clear, confident spoken and written English communication skills, with an outgoing, people-first personality.

Sharp communication paired with genuine listening skills — comfortable being the first voice a customer hears, on the phone and in writing.

Organized and self-directed — you can triage, prioritize, and make good judgment calls without someone looking over your shoulder.

Calm, professional communication style with both everyday retail customers and commercial buyers.

Quick to learn, dependable in execution, and careful with instructions.



BONUS POINTS FOR

--------------------

Comfortable working daily inside Shopify to track orders, leads, monitor abandoned carts, and flag opportunities.

Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

Understanding of AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude AI, etc.



HOW TO APPLY (MUST READ)

--------------------

Send the following:



Your resume

A 60–90 second voice recording (required) covering both parts below:



Voice Recording — what to include:



A. Quick intro: your name and one sentence on your background & sales experience.



B. Live sales scenario: Imagine you're calling a customer who added a vacuum cleaner to their cart but didn't check out. Walk us through how you'd turn that abandoned cart into a sale — including how you'd handle the objection "I'm not ready to buy right now."



We're evaluating tone, confidence, clarity, listening cues, and how naturally you move a prospect toward a close. Polish matters; perfection isn't expected — show us how you actually sound on a real call.



Applications without a voice recording that completes both parts will not be considered. Please include the word REAL in your subject line to confirm you've read this far.



Thank you.

title: Executive Operations Assistant
description:
About the Role:



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur and owner of several growing businesses, primarily in bridal retail, custom embroidery, and home fragrance.



I am highly involved in my businesses and naturally spend much of my time generating ideas, identifying opportunities, solving problems, developing concepts, and determining what I want something to become.



Where I need support is turning those ideas into organized plans, keeping all of the moving pieces connected, following through on the details, and making sure things actually get finished.



I am looking for someone who can become my operational right hand. This is not a traditional virtual assistant role focused primarily on repetitive administrative tasks or waiting for assignments. I need someone who is highly organized, resourceful, proactive, comfortable working independently, and genuinely enjoys closing loops.



You should be the kind of person who can receive a somewhat messy project, organize the information, determine what still needs to happen, coordinate with the people involved, follow up when necessary, and keep moving it forward until it is actually complete.



If finishing things gives you an unreasonable amount of satisfaction, you may be exactly who I'm looking for!





 The Core Purpose of This Role



Your job is essentially to help me do three things:



1. Keep important projects moving.



Turn ideas into actionable plans, identify next steps, coordinate the people involved, track deadlines, follow up, and make sure projects reach completion.



2. Keep me organized and informed.



Maintain my priorities, open loops, outstanding follow-ups, decisions needed, and the information I need to make decisions quickly.



3. Maintain the operating and reporting rhythm across my businesses.



Make sure recurring business reporting is collected, updated, organized, and presented consistently so I can understand what is happening across my companies without personally chasing information from multiple people and systems.



---



Project & Execution Coordination



You will help:



* Turn ideas and conversations into clear projects and next steps

* Maintain a master list of active projects, priorities, and deadlines

* Create simple project plans and timelines

* Identify who owns each next step

* Keep projects moving after the initial planning stage

* Track outstanding tasks, questions, approvals, and decisions

* Maintain an organized list of decisions that require my input

* Identify stalled projects and determine what is preventing progress

* Follow up when deadlines or responses are missed

* Identify potential delays before they become emergencies

* Coordinate product launches, website projects, operational improvements, and other initiatives

* Make sure projects are actually completed rather than remaining indefinitely “in progress”



You will often be responsible for asking:



What are we waiting on?

Who owns the next step?

When is it due?

What does the owner need to d
?

Is anything putting the deadline at risk?

Has this actually been completed?







 Coordinating Across Multiple Businesses



You will work directly for and report to the owner, but your work will span several related businesses.



You may coordinate with:



* Business managers

* Employees

* Marketing staff

* Vendors and suppliers

* Contractors

* Website and ecommerce providers

* Accountants and bookkeepers

* Photographers and creative partners

* Service providers

* Other outside professionals



You will not manage these people directly, your role is to coordinate the machine for me as the owner. That means keeping communication, information, deadlines, decisions, and responsibilities connected so the owner does not have to personally serve as the middle person between everything.



---



Recurring Business Reporting



A meaningful part of this position will involve helping maintain consistent reporting across multiple businesses.



You may:



* Maintain weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reporting

* Collect reporting inputs from employees, software platforms, vendors, and other sources

* Make sure recurring reports are updated on schedule

* Maintain owner dashboards showing important business metrics

* Track business-specific KPIs such as:



  * Sales

  * Appointments

  * Conversion

  * Average transaction or sale

  * Labor/payroll percentages

  * Inventory

  * Production

  * Marketing performance

  * Other relevant operating metrics

* Follow up when reporting information is missing

* Identify unusual, incomplete, or inconsistent numbers that may require attention

* Maintain historical reporting for week-over-week, month-over-month, and year-over-year comparison

* Prepare concise owner summaries showing:



  * What changed

  * What is going well

  * What appears off track

  * What needs attention

  * What decisions are needed

* Help improve and standardize reporting processes over time



You are not expected to be the accountant or bookkeeper. Your responsibility is to make sure the appropriate information is collected, current, organized, and easy for the owner to review. Ultimately, I should be able to ask: “How are all of my businesses doing?” and have organized, current information available without personally collecting it from multiple people.



- Executive Support & Open-Loop Management



You will also help:



* Organize and manage my business inbox

* Draft routine
s and correspondence

* Coordinate meetings and appointments

* Maintain a running list of open loops and outstanding follow-ups

* Maintain an Owner Decisions Needed list

* Track things we are waiting on from other people

* Follow up without requiring me to remember that a follow-up is needed

* Conduct research and summarize findings clearly

* Occasionally assist with personal executive-support needs such as scheduling, travel research, purchases, or researching service providers



A major goal of this role is to reduce the number of unfinished tasks, reminders, deadlines, and follow-ups that the owner has to carry mentally.





 Vendor & Research Support



You may also:



* Research vendors, products, services, and business solutions

* Request pricing and quotes

* Compare costs, shipping, lead times, minimum-order quantities, and other factors

* Track samples, purchases, orders, and shipments

* Maintain organized vendor and supplier information

* Follow up when vendors have not responded

* Research alternatives when something isn't working

* Summarize options clearly

* Provide a recommendation when appropriate



I especially value someone who can come back to me and say: “I researched this. Here are the three best options. I recommend option B, and here's why." (I often over-research and create decision fatigue in myself.) rather than: "I found some information. What do you want me to do?"







Systems & Organization



You will help:



* Maintain project trackers and dashboards

* Organize digital business files and information

* Maintain vendor and account information

* Create and maintain SOPs

* Create recurring checklists

* Document processes

* Help coordinate work in platforms such as Google Workspace, Shopify, spreadsheets, and project-management software

* Notice inefficient or inconsistent processes and suggest better systems



You do not need to know every platform already. I care much more about your ability to learn and figure things out.







 What Working With Me May Look Like



I may come to you and say:  “I want to launch a new candle collection in six weeks. I know which scents I like, I have two possible jars, I talked to someone about packaging but haven't followed back up, we need photography, Shopify needs updated, and marketing needs to be ready before launch.”



I do **not** want someone whose response is: “Okay. Tell me exactly what you'd like me to do.” I am looking for someone whose brain naturally starts thinking:



* What is the final deadline?

* What are the major pieces of this project?

* What needs to happen first?

* What decisions are currently blocking progress?

* Who needs to be contacted?

* What needs to be ordered?

* What can I handle myself?

* What does the owner actually need to d
?

* What could delay the launch?

* What needs to happen this week?

* How will I track everything?

* How do we make sure this actually launches?



You do not need to know anything about candles, bridal gowns, or embroidery. However, you need to know how to figure things out and follow through.







Who I'm Looking For



You may be an excellent fit if you are:



* Extremely organized

* Naturally detail-oriented

* Resourceful

* Proactive

* A strong problem solver

* Comfortable researching unfamiliar subjects

* Comfortable working independently

* A strong written English communicator

* Comfortable communicating professionally with U.S.-based businesses and vendors, as well as international

* Good at following up without needing reminders

* Able to manage several unrelated projects simultaneously

* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and basic business reporting

* Able to summarize complicated information simply

* Good at noticing missing information or missing steps

* Comfortable learning new software

* Comfortable making reasonable decisions independently

* Able to recognize when something truly requires owner approval

* Willing to respectfully push for a decision when a deadline is becoming threatened

* Someone who naturally asks yourself, "What needs to happen next?"



I am specifically looking for a finisher! You do not need to be the most creative person in the room. I need someone who gets satisfaction from taking something that is partially complete and helping get it all the way across the finish line. I am a visionary in the way that I love to come up with ideas, but I struggle with the follow-through.





Relevant Backgrounds



There is no specific degree requirement. Your previous role might have been:



* Executive Assistant

* Executive Operations Assistant

* Operations Assistant

* Operations Coordinator

* Project Coordinator

* Project Manager

* Operations Supervisor

* Online Business Manager

* Office Manager

* Team Leader

* Executive Support

* Founder Support



Experience supporting a U.S.-based entrepreneur or company is helpful but not required. Experience with tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Gmail,  Shopify, Canva, Slack, Asana, or similar software is helpful. Again, I care more about how you think and work than whether you already know every program we use.







This Role Is Probably NOT Right for You If:



* You need detailed instructions before beginning every assignment

* You prefer highly repetitive work with step-by-step directions

* You wait for your manager to tell you what to do next

* You are uncomfortable making recommendations

* You consider something complete simply because you sent one

* You wait indefinitely when another person does not respond

* You need someone else to remind you about deadlines

* You avoid following up because you are worried about bothering someone

* You automatically treat every new idea as an immediate priority

* You are primarily seeking a social-media, graphic-design, or data-entry position







Schedule & Work Environment



This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week to start. Most work can be completed on a flexible schedule. However, I need approximately 2–3 hours of reliable overlap with U.S. Central Time on working days so that we can communicate, make decisions, and keep projects moving.



You should have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A reliable computer

* A quiet and professional work environment

* A backup plan for internet or power interruptions

* Comfort communicating through video calls, chat, and







Growth Opportunity



I am looking for a long-term working relationship, not temporary help. I value establishing relationships with people that I trust. If the partnership works well, there is significant opportunity for:



* Increased hours

* Increased compensation

* More responsibility

* Ownership of larger projects

* Deeper involvement across the businesses

* Professional growth into a larger operations role



My goal is eventually to have someone who understands how I think, understands my businesses, knows what matters to me, and becomes a trusted operational extension of me.





How to Apply



Please submit your résumé and answer all 7 questions below. Please do not send only a generic cover letter.



1. The Mess



Tell me about something you inherited at work that was disorganized, incomplete, or falling apart. What condition was it in What did you do? What was the result?



2. The Follow-Through



Tell me about a project where the owner, manager, or person you worked for became busy or distracted before the project was finished. What did you do to make sure it still got completed?



3. Ten Ideas



Imagine your boss comes to you with ten exciting new ideas in one week and appears genuinely enthusiastic about all ten. What would you do?



 4. Figure It Out



Tell me about a problem you encountered at work that you had never dealt with before. How did you figure out what to do?



5. Judgment



How do you d
 when to make a decision yourself versus when to bring the decision back to the owner?



6. Finishing



Which part of a project do you naturally enjoy most?



A. Coming up with the idea

B. Creating the initial plan

C. Coordinating the people and resources

D. Working through the final details and completing it



Please explain your answer.



7. The Follow-Up



Imagine you need a decision from me before you can continue a project. You remind me once, I don't respond. You remind me again, I still don't respond, and the project deadline is now at risk. What do you do next?



Finally, somewhere in your application, please answer this question:



When you are waiting on someone else before you can complete a task, how do you personally make sure that task does not get forgotten?



I look forward to hearing from you - thank you for taking the time to consider this position!

title: Bookkeeper
description:
***How to Apply***

Bookkeeper



Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM HKT (Monday to Friday) including 1-hour lunch break and 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM HKT (Saturday)



JOB SUMMARY



We are seeking a highly skilled and organized Bookkeeper with strong hands-on experience with Xero to manage our financial records and ensure accurate bookkeeping practices. The Bookkeeper will work as a Contractor and play a key role in maintaining financial transactions, reconciling accounts, preparing financial statements, and assisting in financial reporting. This position requires strong attention to detail, proficiency in Xero, and the ability to work independently.



With a high level of attention to detail and a focus on delivering accurate work on time, you should be able to transform a conversation into high-quality documents and instructions.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Financial Data Management:

o Record day-to-day financial transactions, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, and general ledger entries.

o Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, ensuring proper classification and coding of transactions.

o Track and manage petty cash to ensure accurate recording of small expenditures.

o Categorize and allocate expenses to the appropriate accounts.

o Perform bank reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of financial data entries.

o Track financial transactions by building up accounts, completing the posting process, and ensuring compliance with legal requirements.



• Financial Reporting and Analysis:

o Prepare and analyze monthly Profit and Loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.

o Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

o Provide insights into financial performance to support decision-making processes.



• Payroll and Benefits Administration:

o Process payroll, ensuring accurate calculations of salaries, deductions, and benefits.

o Maintain employee payroll records.

o Coordinate with HR to ensure compliance with payroll regulations and timely submission of required reports.



• Compliance:

o Assist in the preparation of financial data for audits, ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulations.

o Collaborate with external auditors, providing necessary documentation and support during the auditing process.

o Ensure alignment with tax laws, reporting requirements, and tax filing deadlines.

o Stay updated on changes in accounting standards and regulations to ensure ongoing compliance.



• Inventory and Purchase Order Management:

o Monitor incoming, outgoing, and shipped products.

o Coordinate with the supply chain department to track inventory levels, purchase orders, and reconcile received goods.

o Collaborate with the supply chain team to resolve any discrepancies or issues related to inventory or purchase orders.



• Financial Systems and Process Improvement:

o Set up bookkeeping policies and procedures.

o Help lessen control risk in the inventory process by suggesting policies.

o Identify opportunities for process improvement in financial systems and procedures, recommending and implementing changes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.



QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS



• Minimum three (3) years of relevant experience in Bookkeeping or Accounting roles.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Strong hands-on experience with Xero software is a must.

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and bookkeeping practices.

• Experience in integrations (e.g., DEXT) is a plus.

• Experience with inventory management systems such as Cin7 or similar systems is a big plus.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high attention to detail.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.



Essential Requirements for Remote Work:

• Reliable Laptop or Desktop Computer.

• Stable and high-speed internet connection.

• Power source and backup internet connection in case of electricity interruptions.





Note: Only successful candidates will be contacted for the next phase of the selection process. We appreciate your time and interest in joining our team.

What We Expect



Accuracy: Financial information must be checked before it is reported.

Ownership: If something does not reconcile or information is missing, investigate and follow through until it is resolved.

Timeliness: Monthly accounts and recurring finance tasks must stay current.

Early escalation: Raise discrepancies, cash-flow concerns, missing documents or compliance risks early.

Documentation: Records must be organized so another person can understand and verify the work.

Improvement: Identify recurring errors or inefficient processes and recommend practical improvements.



Qualifications & Skills



Minimum 2–3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong hands-on experience with Xero.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations and financial statements.

Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial data.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Able to work independently and manage recurring deadlines.

Good written and spoken English.

Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools for research and administrative work.

Experience with inventory-based businesses is an advantage.

HR or administrative experience is an advantage but not required.

Accounting or Finance qualifications are preferred, but demonstrated practical bookkeeping capability and accuracy are more important.



How Success Is Measured



Success means the company accounts remain accurate, reconciled and up to date, monthly financial information can be relied upon, outstanding issues are identified early, and management does not need to repeatedly check or chase routine Finance, HR and administrative work.

At Skinnify (www.skinnify.co), we make clothing with built-in resistance - leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more - that turn everyday movements like walking, cooking, or commuting into a passive workout. In just three years, we've grown from 0 to 150,000+ customers – and we're just getting started.



To get a better idea of our company and what it's like to work on our team, check out this short video:





Now, we're looking for a full-time Video Editor (40 hours/week) to bring our ad creatives to life - someone who can take raw footage and turn it into powerful, polished videos that drive sales and build our community.

????????????????????

???? Your Responsibilities

? Edit high-converting video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Google

? Bring creative briefs to life with fast, compelling edits that match the hook, angle, and storyline

? Create a variety of formats, from short-form direct response ads to longer-form VSLs and advertorial-style content

? Work closely with content creators, creative strategists, and media buyers to deliver assets that perform

? Collaborate on new ad concepts and contribute creative input during brainstorming

? Stay ahead of platform trends, meme culture, and editing styles to keep our content fresh

? Manage and organize video assets, templates, and versioning for efficient turnaround

? Continuously iterate based on data and feedback to improve performance

????????????????????

???? What We're Looking For

?? DTC E-Commerce Experience – This is a mandatory requirement. You've successfully edited ads for ecommerce brands and understand direct-response marketing

?? Performance-Driven Editing – You know what keeps people watching and what drives clicks, conversions, and purchases

?? High Output Capacity – You can consistently deliver 5-10 creative briefs per week across different formats, from 30-second ads to 2-3+ minute VSLs

?? Fast Turnaround – You can edit quickly without sacrificing quality

?? Strong Visual Taste – Your edits look polished, modern, engaging, and conversion-focused

?? Collaborative Yet Independent – You're great at taking feedback and even better at executing without constant supervision

?? Organized & Detail-Oriented – You don't miss deadlines and your file management is on point

????????????????????

???? Why Join Skinnify?

???? Join a Hyper-Growth Brand – From 0 to 150,000+ customers in 3 years. Your edits will directly influence sales and brand growth.

???? Real Career Growth – Your trajectory here is whatever you make of it. One team member went from video editor to creative strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team.

???? Full Flexibility – Work from anywhere, anytime. We run on trust and results, not time tracking — as long as the work gets done, your hours are yours.

???? Learning Budget – Courses, books, consulting calls - we cover it. Many team members book calls with founders of major ecommerce brands and industry experts through platforms like intro.co and mentorpass.co.

?? Two Company Retreats a Year, Fully Paid – We rent a house in a new country each time, explore together, and actually get to know each other.

? Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor.

????????????????????

???????? The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life - his mom, his sister, his friends - wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall.

The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively - while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk?

The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked - so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.

????????????????????

????? Our Products

What started with a single product - leggings with built-in resistance bands - has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more.

We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.

????????????????????

???? Skinnify's Core Values

???? Innovation – We design new, groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.

???? Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories & get fitter with every step.

???? Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone - even the busiest and least motivated.

???? Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.

? Quality – Our products are built to last - high-quality, durable, and reliable.

Ready to edit your way into the future of fitness? Apply now and let's create something powerful.

title: Creative Editor For Affiliate Marketing Offers
description:
Performance Creative Editor (UGC)



Remote 





About the role



We run Meta ads for affiliate offers. You make the videos that drive the sales. This is not a "make it look pretty" job. Your ads are judged on one thing: do they convert and make money. You will edit UGC-style video ads, test them, read the numbers, and cut the next version based on what worked.





What you will do



- Edit UGC-style video ads for Meta: hooks, talking-head clips, B-roll, captions, and text overlays.



to be considered, answer this: who is the current president of Albania?



- Understand the offer before you touch the footage: who the customer is, what they get, what the payout is, and what the landing page asks them to do.



- Write or shape the script so the hook stops the scroll, the body builds the reason to act, and the ending pushes them to click.



- Produce many versions fast: new hooks, new openers, new angles on the same offer.



- Read the results in Ads Manager and the tracker: CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS. Know which of your ads are profitable and which are not.



- Cut the losers, double down on the winners, and explain why one worked and the other did not.



- Study competitor ads and spy tools to see what is converting in the niche right now.



- Keep every hook, script, and asset organized so the team can reuse them.





What you need



- Real experience editing UGC video ads that ran with real money behind them. Portfolio required.



- You understand affiliate marketing: offers, networks, payouts, landing pages, and why an ad that gets clicks can still lose money.



- You think in numbers. You know what CPA and ROAS mean and you care about them more than about likes.



- You know direct response: hooks, pain points, proof, call to action.



- You are fast. Volume matters. You can turn out several variations a day.





- Clear English. You can write a natural-sounding script.





Nice to have



- Experience with home services, insurance, finance, or lead generation offers.



- Experience with AI video and voice tools for UGC.



- Experience running your own Meta ads.





Pay



Base pay plus a bonus tied to the profit your ads generate.

title: Development Representative (BDR) - Fintology (B2B Fintech, US Hours, Full Time)
description:
Fintology is hiring a full-time Business Development Representative (BDR) to work US business hours (9 AM–5 PM, Monday–Friday, Eastern Time / Atlanta GA HQ). 

You'll call and qualify inbound business leads and book them onto our closers' calendars. Leads are provided. This is not a traditional cold-calling position.



About Fintology: 

Fintology is a B2B Lending Operating System a business in a box for companies that need access to funding. We connect business owners with a network of 4,500+ lenders, helping them explore financing opportunities across a wide range of credit profiles and industries. The prospects you'll communicate with have already expressed interest in getting funding or learning more about their options. Your role is to turn that interest into conversations, relationships, qualified opportunities, and appointments. 



The BDR will be responsible for engaging inbound business leads, identifying and qualifying potential opportunities, building relationships with prospective clients, and scheduling qualified prospects with our sales closers. This role requires strong communication skills, consistent follow-up, organization, and the ability to effectively move prospects through the early stages of the sales pipeline.



Compensation:

Pay is $5.00/hour PLUS 10% commission on every deal that closes from your appointments  and that 10% doesn't stop after one payout. It's a flat rate that compounds every month the client stays active, so the longer you stay and the more you close, the higher your monthly floor climbs. Leads come to us this isn't cold-calling strangers.



Commission is paid monthly for as long as the client remains active. As the BDR generates additional qualified opportunities that convert into active clients, their recurring commission base has the opportunity to increase.



Actual earnings will vary based on individual performance, closed deals, client revenue, and client retention.

We work with business owners seeking financing and connect them with lending opportunities based on their business needs and qualifications. The prospects assigned to the BDR have already expressed interest in learning more about business funding options.



What You'll Do:

-  Contact and follow up with inbound business leads via phone, text, and

-  Engage prospective clients and establish professional relationships

-  Identify business needs and determine whether prospects meet qualification criteria

-  Educate prospects on Fintology's services and next steps

-  Qualify leads and schedule appointments with sales closers

-  Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects throughout the qualification process

-  Re-engage leads who have not responded or are not yet ready to move forward

-  Respond to common questions and objections using Fintology's established sales framework

-  Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect information, notes, activities, and statuses in the CRM

-  Manage assigned leads and follow-up activities efficiently

-  Meet established daily and weekly performance expectations, including calls, conversations, appointments booked, and show-up rates

-  Collaborate with the sales team to ensure qualified prospects are properly transitioned to closers

-  Follow established scripts, sales processes, and objection-handling procedures



What We're Looking For:

-  Excellent spoken and written English IS required

-  Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills

-  Ability to communicate professionally and confidently with business owners

-  Strong relationship-building and customer engagement skills

-  Ability to remain persistent and professional when handling objections or rejection

-  Strong organizational and time-management skills

-  Ability to manage multiple leads and follow-up activities simultaneously

-  Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment with measurable activity and sales goals

-  Coachable and able to follow established sales processes

-  Self-motivated, dependable, and accountable for individual performance

-  Consistent availability during required working hours

-  Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, headset, and quiet, distraction-free workspace



Preferred, but not required:

-  Previous BDR, SDR, inside sales, or business development experience

-  Previous customer service or client relationship experience

-  Experience with CRM or auto-dialer platforms such as GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, or Salesforce

-  Experience working in a commission-based or performance-driven sales environment



Schedule: 

Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM- 5:00 PM Eastern Time 

Consistent attendance and availability throughout the scheduled shift are required. This is not a flexible or self-paced position.



How to Apply



Please submit the following with your application:

1. Your current resume

2. Upload a 60–90 second LOOM VIDEO introducing yourself in English

3. Confirmation that you are available to work 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday–Friday

4. A list of any CRM, dialer, or sales platforms you have previously used



**Applications that do not include the requested information may not be considered.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO — Path to Operations Manager
description:
Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Part-time initially, with the opportunity to become full-time within several months

Starting compensation: $5–$10 USD per hour, based on experience and demonstrated ability

Reports directly to: Founder and CEO



Executive Summary



Bellaura is seeking an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant to work directly with its founder and CEO. This is a high-trust role for someone intelligent, ambitious, organized, and unusually strong at turning priorities into completed work. The position can grow into an Operations Manager role with responsibility for interviewing, hiring, delegating to, and leading a team of specialized virtual assistants.



The Opportunity



Bellaura is an early-stage technology startup building a platform for creators, creative professionals, events, collaboration, and bookings.



Our team includes several Microsoft engineers and other experienced U.S.-based professionals currently contributing for equity because they believe in the company’s potential. This Executive Assistant will be one of a small number of team members receiving cash compensation during the company’s early stage.



This is not intended to remain a traditional assistant role. The right person will become the CEO’s operational right hand, take ownership of increasingly important responsibilities, and grow based on performance rather than tenure.



What You Will Do

Executive support and priority management

Organize the CEO’s calendar, meetings, priorities, reminders, and follow-ups.

Turn conversations and ideas into clear action items.

Track commitments and ensure important work is completed.

Assist with both business and reasonable personal administrative needs.

Project and operations coordination

Maintain project trackers, deadlines, owners, and next steps.

Coordinate team members, creators, contractors, vendors, events, and other projects.

Identify stalled work, missing information, and approaching deadlines.

Create checklists, procedures, templates, and repeatable systems.

Communication and follow-through

Draft professional
s, messages, meeting notes, and follow-ups.

Coordinate people across different schedules and time zones.

Follow up firmly and professionally when work is overdue.

Communicate problems early and provide concise progress updates.

Research and decision support

Conduct thorough online and ChatGPT-assisted research.

Compare candidates, vendors, tools, services, and opportunities.

Summarize findings clearly and recommend practical next steps.

Use Excel or similar spreadsheets to organize and evaluate information.

Recruiting and team leadership



As trust and responsibility increase, you may:



Write job descriptions and review applications.

Interview candidates and evaluate trial projects.

Recommend or make hiring decisions.

Onboard and manage specialized virtual assistants.

Delegate work, review quality, and hold team members accountable.

Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



Highly intelligent, resourceful, and quick to learn.

Fluent in written and spoken English.

Extremely organized, punctual, and dependable.

Able to execute quickly without becoming careless.

Comfortable juggling many responsibilities at once.

Self-directed and able to make progress without constant supervision.

Confident following up, delegating, and holding others accountable.

Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information.

Comfortable working in an early-stage company where priorities evolve.



Previous executive-assistant, founder-support, project-coordination, recruiting, or operations experience is strongly preferred.



A completed bachelor’s degree is required. Some Excel experience and strong proficiency using ChatGPT for research are preferred, but no specific software background is mandatory.



Academic and Personal Achievement



We are interested in more than simply whether you completed a degree. Strong candidates will have demonstrated meaningful achievement through academics, extracurricular activities, entrepreneurship, leadership, or independent projects.



Relevant examples include:



Graduating with honors or earning a competitive scholarship.

Leading a student organization or major extracurricular initiative.

Building a profitable side business or successful freelance practice.

Organizing an event, community, project, or campaign.

Winning a competition or completing a difficult independent goal.

Managing demanding work and personal responsibilities while performing at a high level.



The central question is: What have you accomplished through your own initiative, beyond what was required of you?



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed



You will likely succeed in this role if you naturally:



Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

Solve problems rather than only reporting them.

Close loops and follow through without repeated reminders.

Prioritize effectively when many things appear urgent.

Accept direct feedback and improve quickly.

Understand when to act independently and when to ask for approval.

Want to become a leader, not remain limited to assigned administrative tasks.

Career Growth



The role will begin as Executive Assistant to the CEO and may grow into an Operations Manager position based on demonstrated performance and company needs.



Growth may include:



Taking ownership of the CEO’s operating systems and priorities.

Managing recurring workflows and projects independently.

Creating processes that improve company execution.

Recruiting and managing additional virtual assistants.

Leading parts of the company’s day-to-day operations.



There is no guaranteed promotion timeline. Greater responsibility and compensation will be earned through excellent judgment, reliability, leadership, and measurable results.



Schedule and Compensation

Part-time initially, with the opportunity to become full-time within several months.

Flexible working schedule with required attendance at specific meetings.

Starting compensation of $5–$10 USD per hour.

Compensation can increase based on performance, responsibility, and company growth.

Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid trial project.

How to Apply



Please submit your resume or CV, current location in the Philippines, weekly availability, preferred hourly rate, and answers to the following three questions:



1. What are your most significant achievements that demonstrate your own initiative?



Describe up to three accomplishments. At least one should involve something beyond normal school or employment requirements, such as a profitable side business, leadership position, independent project, competition, or difficult personal goal.



2. Tell us about a time you executed quickly while juggling many responsibilities.



Explain how you prioritized the work, coordinated the people involved, handled deadlines, and achieved the final result.



3. Why do you want to become the CEO’s right hand and potentially grow into operations leadership?



Connect your answer to your experience, strengths, ambitions, and long-term professional goals.



Optional video introduction



You may include a one- to two-minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong fit. Production quality is not important; the video is simply an opportunity to demonstrate your spoken English, confidence, and communication style.

title: Video Editor - Instagram Reels & AI Graphics
description:
I’m looking for someone to help me edit 5–7 Instagram Reels a week for my personal brand. I create content about AI tools and workflows for small and medium-sized businesses, especially owners who are bootstrapping and looking for practical ways to save time.



I’ll provide the footage, creative direction, and examples of how I want the videos edited. I need someone who can take that direction, get familiar with my style, and consistently turn around good work.



The work

Most videos will be short-form content for Instagram. Editing will include cutting footage, adding captions and on-screen text, and using screen recordings, graphics, music, and sound effects where they make sense.

I’d also like to work with someone who’s interested in experimenting with AI tools for graphics and motion graphics. You don’t need to know every tool already, but you should be curious and willing to learn.



What I’m looking for

- Experience editing Reels or other short-form videos, with examples you can share.

- CapCut experience is preferred, but I’m open to other editing software.

- A good sense of pacing and an eye for clean, readable captions and graphics.

- Good English comprehension and clear communication.

- Someone who takes feedback well and applies it to future videos.

- Availability to deliver finished videos within 1–2 days of receiving the footage and instructions, including any revisions.

- Some overlap with Pacific Time, especially at the beginning while we’re working through my editing style.



YouTube editing experience would be a bonus, as I’d eventually like to create longer videos too.

This is a part-time role to start. Getting familiar with the tools and my style may take some extra time initially. I’d love to find someone who can get up to speed fairly quickly and work with me over the long term as the brand grows.



If you’re interested, please send:

- A little about yourself and your editing experience.

- Links to 2–3 videos you’ve edited.

- The editing software and any AI tools you use.

- How many hours a week you’re available and whether you can overlap with Pacific Time.

- Whether you can manage 5–7 Reels a week with a 1–2 day turnaround.

title: Senior Video Editor & Colorist — Event, Music & Commercial Work (DaVinci Resolve + Premiere Pro)
description:
Cube World Films is a full-service video production company in Southern California. We shoot concerts and festivals, DJ sets, corporate events, drone and FPV aerials, real estate, and social content. We've produced work for creators including Ben Azelart, the Nelk Boys, Sofie Dossi, and Anna McNulty. We're looking for an editor who can take our footage and finish it at a level our clients would expect from a high-end agency.



What you'd be working with:



Sony FX3 footage shot in S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine

DJI drone and FPV aerials

Multicam event and concert coverage, often with separate audio

Podcast and interview footage



What we need you to do:



Edit EVENT recaps, CONCERT AND DJ FILMS/SETS, brand and corporate pieces, and short-form cutdowns

Color grade in DaVinci Resolve — proper node-based grading, not a LUT dropped on the timeline. You should be comfortable with color management, matching cameras and shots across a project, and building a consistent look for a client's brand

Edit primarily in Premiere Pro (Resolve for finishing is fine if your workflow is clean and you can round-trip)

Handle audio properly: sync, cleanup, music beds, levels that hold up on a phone speaker and in a theater

Work to a turnaround of one to two weeks per project, and tell us early if something is going to slip

WHAT YOU WILL DO

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- You can build a branched workflow and explain why a given contact did not enrol

- Professional written and spoken English

- Consistent availability during 9am-5pm US Pacific

NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- HTML/CSS comfort for
 and landing page templates

- 6sense, HG Insights or another ABM/intent platform

Escalating a question stops the clock; guessing does not. Structural and destructive changes are reviewed by us before they go live.

Your focus is on pitching, continuing follow up and getting me booked in podcasts and other speaking opportunities to spread the brand message. 



Some context:  Built in the Chaos is my book and keynote speech. It is the way I reach new audiences for my co-founded brand Lead Through the Noise, which is a women’s focused brand that helps women cut through the noise and complexity in their lives to lead and thrive in business, career and life.  We have a membership community, run live events and plan to launch retreats in 2028.



This is not a job where you check the inbox once a week and call it done. I need someone who is able to own the process and follow up multiple days a week.  



What You'll Do

Asset Creation: Work with me to update my speaker bio (short and long versions), keynote description, topic one-sheet, and podcast pitch templates, all based on my brand voice and existing materials. I'll give you source content and feedback, you'll turn it into polished, ready-to-send assets.

Research: Find podcasts, corporate events, women's leadership conferences, entrepreneurial summits, and virtual summits that fit my audience: high-achieving women balancing business, motherhood, and ambition.

Pitching: Write and send customized outreach
s and booking applications to event organizers and podcast hosts, using the assets above.

Calendar Coordination: Schedule pre-interviews, tech checks, and confirmed speaking dates, and keep my calendar updated.

Reporting: Send me a brief weekly update on pitches sent, responses received, and bookings confirmed.

Event Support (growing scope): Our first live event is already planned, no work needed there. As future events and retreats get added to the calendar, help research and coordinate venues, vendors, and logistics.

title: Local SEO - Link Building & Citations VA
description:
The Role

We're a local SEO agency. We handle search visibility for automotive shops across the US.



We do the strategy. We research every client, analyze their competitors, and build the exact link plan for every platform, directory, profile, and outreach target, listed out before you start.



Your job is to execute that list. Nothing in this role requires you to decide what to do. It requires you to do it correctly, log it properly, and not cut corners.



If you want a role where you pitch ideas and build strategy, this isn't it. If you're good at detailed, repetitive work and you take pride in a clean tracker, keep reading.



What You'll Actually Do

1. Directory & profile submissions: Create and fully complete business profiles on the platforms we assign. Not just name and phone categories, full description, hours, services, photos, logo. A half-filled profile is a wasted submission.



2. Citations & NAP consistency: Submit business listings matching our master record exactly — character for character. Flag duplicate or outdated listings that need claiming or removal.



3. Outreach links: Find the right contact at a target site (chambers, associations, suppliers, sponsors, local orgs), send our template, personalize the opening line, run the follow-up sequence, and log every reply.



4. Link reclamation & fixes: Chase down unlinked brand mentions, broken links pointing to our clients, and links that dropped or went nofollow.



5. Daily tracker updates: Every task logged in Airtable with its status and the live URL. This is not optional, and it's the thing we'll evaluate you on hardest.



What You Will NOT Do

Touch any client's Google Business Profile

Decide which sites to target or what the strategy is

Talk directly to clients

Anything that needs a decision gets flagged to us. You never guess.



What We Give You

AdsPower browser profile per client, pre-configured

Dedicated residential proxy per client

Dedicated
 per client

Airtable base with your full task list and tracker

Complete client info pack NAP, descriptions, categories, logos, photos, service lists

Written SOPs for every task type

Outreach templates, already written

You will not be figuring this out on your own. Everything is documented.



Requirements

Prior experience with directory submissions, citation building, or link building (tell us specifically what you've done)

Genuinely detail-obsessed you notice when an address says "St." on one listing and "Street" on another, and you understand why that matters

Written English good enough to send a professional outreach

Reliable internet and a setup that can run multiple browser profiles

Comfortable working from a task list without being chased

Available 4+ hours overlapping US business hours

Nice to have (not required):



Used AdsPower or any other similar tools

Used Airtable

Worked across multiple client accounts at once

Paid Trial

Before we hire, we pay you for a short trial:



Ten citation submissions for one client, using our browser profile, our client info, and our tracker.



Do the work exactly the way you'd do it on a normal day. We'll review it and give you feedback either way.



Takes most people 1 to 2 hours. Paid: we'll agree on the amount before you start.



To Apply

Reply with the word CITATION at the top of your message, then answer these four questions. Applications without the keyword or the answers get deleted.



1. A client's address is listed as "1420 N Main St, Suite B." One directory only has a single address field, with no suite line. What do you enter, and why?



2. A directory requires a phone call or SMS to verify the listing, but you don't have access to the client's phone. What do you do?



3. You submit a listing, and it says "pending review." How do you mark that in the tracker, and what do you do next?



4. Name one specific directory or citation site you've submitted to before, and one thing about it that annoyed you.

volume. As the business continues to scale, we are looking for an experienced, dependable

Dispute Manager to protect revenue and manage chargebacks across our payment platforms.



The role

This is a hands-on operational role focused on reviewing disputes, gathering evidence and

submitting strong responses before each deadline.



You do not need to build a complex department or manage a large team. You need to

understand e-commerce disputes, follow clear SOPs, stay organised and consistently submit

accurate evidence.



The role may begin part-time, with the possibility of becoming full-time depending on

experience, availability and business needs.



Responsibilities

● Review incoming chargebacks, disputes, RFIs and pre-dispute alerts.

fraud checks and payment data.

● Handle disputes across platforms such as Shopify Payments, Stripe, PayPal and Klarna.

● Follow existing SOPs and recommend practical improvements.

fraud.

● Experience preparing and submitting dispute evidence—not only reviewing or reporting

on cases.

● Working knowledge of Shopify Payments, Stripe, PayPal, Klarna or similar platforms.

● Strong written English and persuasive evidence-writing skills.

● Excellent organisation, accuracy and deadline management.

● Experience working with dispute SOPs and documented processes.

● Reliable internet connection and the ability to work independently.

Preferred experience

● Experience reducing chargeback rates or improving dispute win rates.

● Familiarity with fraud indicators, proof of delivery, subscription disputes and “product not

received” or “not as described” claims.

● Experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, Shopify Admin or chargeback-alert platforms.

● Background in customer support, payment operations or revenue protection.

● Experience creating or improving SOPs and dispute templates.



Compensation and working arrangement

● Compensation: $750 USD per month.

● Location: Fully remote.

● Schedule: Part-time or full-time, depending on the successful candidate.

● Engagement: Long-term opportunity for someone who performs consistently as the

business grows.



How to apply



Please answer the following questions:

1. Which e-commerce brands have you supported, and what did they sell?

 video content

* Turning videos into authoritative written LinkedIn posts

 MARKETING

* Scheduling approved broadcast emails

* Loading automated email sequences

* Segmenting contacts using established criteria

* Testing subject lines and calls to action

* Checking links, spelling, formatting, and mobile appearance

* Maintaining email tags and contact lists

* Supporting lead-nurture and client-education campaigns

* Identifying emails that generate diagnostic completions, appointments, or purchases

* Maintaining active unsubscribe and compliance functions



SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT



You will help manage the daily execution of VLARI’s social-media presence.



Responsibilities may include:



* Scheduling and publishing approved content

* Monitoring comments and direct messages

* Responding to basic questions using approved responses

* Escalating client-specific or technical questions

* Maintaining consistent branding across all accounts

* Checking profile links and calls to action

* Supporting ManyChat and GoHighLevel workflows

* Maintaining accurate campaign and lead-source information

* Identifying outdated content, links, offers, or profile information

* Monitoring trends relevant to the company’s audience

* Recommending ways to adapt relevant trends without weakening the brand

* Identifying high-performing content that should be reused or expanded



MARKETING ANALYTICS



You will track business results, not only likes and followers.



Relevant measurements may include:



* Reach and views

* Watch time

* Audience retention

* Saves and shares

* Comments and direct messages

* Link clicks

* Email opens and clicks

* Diagnostic starts

* Diagnostic completions

* Qualified leads

* Appointment requests

* Purchases

* Client conversions

* Revenue connected to specific content or campaigns



You will prepare a simple weekly report showing:



* What was published

* What performed best

* What generated qualified engagement

* What produced leads or conversions

* What should be tested next

* What requires management attention



PAID ADVERTISING SUPPORT



This position may support paid advertising by:



* Organizing approved advertising assets

* Uploading approved creative and copy

* Maintaining campaign naming and tracking standards

* Monitoring whether advertisements, links, and forms are functioning

* Coordinating with an outside advertising specialist or agency

* Preparing basic performance reports

* Identifying successful organic content that may be suitable for advertising

* Tracking leads from advertisement through conversion



You will not independently change advertising budgets, targeting, offers, or major campaign strategy unless specifically authorized.



BRAND AND COMPLIANCE STANDARDS



VLARI serves an established and sophisticated audience. All content must be professional, credible, polished, and consistent.



You must:



* Follow approved messaging and terminology

* Maintain the company’s established visual identity

* Use only approved colors, fonts, logos, images, and presenter assets

* Proofread and review all content before submitting it for approval

* Verify names, dates, figures, links, and claims

* Use approved disclosures when required

* Protect client confidentiality

* Protect company intellectual property

* Maintain organized records of approvals and published content

* Promise tax savings or financial results

* Publish unverified financial figures

* Provide tax, legal, investment, or insurance advice

* Respond to individualized strategy questions

* Recommend insurance or financial products

* Use actual client information without written authorization

* Create fictional testimonials

* Remove or alter approved disclosures

* Publish content using the founder’s image, voice, or AI presenter without authorization

* Change company pricing, offers, positioning, or strategy

* Share internal scripts, systems, credentials, or intellectual property



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have experience managing social media for a U.S.-based company or professional brand

* Understand both short-form and long-form content

* Can edit videos and create professional visual assets

* Have email-marketing experience

* Are comfortable using AI content-production tools

* Can follow detailed brand and messaging guidelines

* Understand that marketing should generate measurable business activity

* Ability to meet deadlines consistently

* Availability for scheduled overlap with U.S. Pacific Time

* Willingness to sign confidentiality, data-security, intellectual-property, voice, image, and AI-asset agreements
