title: Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT VLARI



VLARI is a specialized U.S.-based advisory firm serving established business owners. We work with a limited number of clients and prioritize quality, accuracy, confidentiality, and thoughtful service over high case volume.



We are seeking a reliable, highly organized Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator for a full-time, long-term position.



This is a versatile role for someone who enjoys managing detailed processes, communicating professionally with clients, organizing financial documents, and ensuring that every case continues moving forward.



This is not a sales, call-center, or independent advisory position. You will receive training in our internal processes. You will begin with client onboarding, administrative support, document organization, and case coordination. As you demonstrate proficiency, your responsibilities may expand into preliminary case preparation and implementation tracking.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Once a client completes payment, you will become the client’s primary operational contact.



You will own the administrative journey from payment through completed onboarding and preparation of a review-ready client file.



You will make sure clients understand what is required, submit the appropriate documents, answer all required intake questions, receive timely updates, and progress through each stage of the engagement.



POST-PAYMENT CLIENT ONBOARDING



Your responsibilities will include:



* Sending welcome communications immediately after payment

* Explaining the onboarding process and next steps

* Providing access to the secure client portal

* Confirming completion of engagement documents and required acknowledgments

* Scheduling onboarding, review, and presentation meetings

* Guiding clients through intake questionnaires

* Asking approved follow-up questions when information is incomplete

* Providing and explaining the required-document checklist

* Collecting tax returns, financial statements, payroll records, entity documents, insurance information, investment statements, and other requested records

* Reviewing documents for completeness, legibility, correct reporting periods, and missing pages

* Comparing submitted documents against the client’s checklist

* Following up professionally for missing information

* Documenting the client’s objectives, concerns, priorities, and unanswered questions

* Entering and verifying information in company systems

* Maintaining accurate notes, tasks, deadlines, and pipeline stages

* Preparing a consolidated internal case summary

* Identifying inconsistencies and questions that require escalation

* Confirming when the client’s file is complete and ready for professional review

* Sending appropriate progress updates throughout the engagement

* Coordinating communication among the client, company leadership, and assigned professionals



CASE AND IMPLEMENTATION COORDINATION



After training, your responsibilities may also include:



* Organizing financial and business information for internal analysis

* Extracting designated information from financial statements and tax documents

* Preparing preliminary internal summaries for review

* Operating internal assessment and case-preparation systems

* Coordinating reviews with accountants, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other specialists

* Recording professional feedback and requested changes

* Preparing meeting briefs and client presentation materials

* Creating and maintaining implementation checklists

* Assigning and tracking approved implementation steps

* Following up with clients and outside professionals

* Assisting with insurance and annuity application processing

* Tracking applications, signatures, transfers, funding, and outstanding requirements

* Communicating with insurance carriers and related organizations

* Maintaining accurate case statuses until completion

* Escalating matters requiring professional judgment or approval



ADMINISTRATIVE AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Because VLARI serves a limited number of quality clients, this position will support several areas of the business. Additional responsibilities may include:



* Managing calendars and appointment confirmations

* Monitoring and organizing company email

* Answering and routing administrative client calls

* Drafting routine client communications

* Updating CRM records and pipeline stages

* Organizing company files and folders

* Maintaining standard operating procedures

* Auditing client files for missing information

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping and operational reporting

* Maintaining service and follow-up calendars

* Researching administrative information when assigned

* Testing intake forms, reports, and internal workflows

* Supporting special company projects during lower-volume periods



PROFESSIONAL BOUNDARIES



You will explain company processes, collect factual information, answer approved administrative questions, and coordinate work that has already been authorized.



You will not be expected or authorized to independently:



* Provide U.S. tax advice

* Provide legal advice

* Recommend investments, insurance policies, or annuities

* Approve client strategies

* Promise financial or tax results

* Represent yourself as a U.S.-licensed professional

* Release a final client design without approval



Any question involving professional judgment or a recommendation must be documented and escalated to the appropriate professional.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have an accounting, bookkeeping, business administration, insurance, or financial-services background

* Have experience supporting U.S. clients or companies

* Are comfortable reviewing financial documents

* Communicate clearly and professionally by email, telephone, and video

* Are highly organized and careful with details

* Follow instructions and documented procedures

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Are comfortable performing both analytical and routine administrative work

* Know when to ask questions or escalate an issue

* Enjoy managing cases from beginning to completion

* Want a stable, long-term role with one company

* Respect confidentiality and sensitive client information

* Prefer quality and accuracy over high-volume, rushed work

* Are interested in growing within an organization rather than building a competing advisory practice



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong spoken and written English

* At least two years of relevant administrative, bookkeeping, accounting, insurance, client-service, or case-management experience

* Strong spreadsheet, email, and document-management skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Leadership Skills

* Managerial Skills

* Professional telephone presence

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Quiet and professional environment for client calls

* Ability to handle confidential financial information

* Ability to organize multiple cases and deadlines

* Willingness to complete reference and background checks

* Willingness to sign confidentiality, data-security, and intellectual-property agreements

* Availability for scheduled overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



* QuickBooks Online

* GoHighLevel or another CRM

* U.S. bookkeeping or accounting

* U.S. business financial statements

* U.S. business tax documents

* Client onboarding

* Life-insurance or annuity case processing

* Financial-advisor support

* Tax Strategies

* Project Manager

* Project Coordinator

* DocuSign or secure client portals

* Workflow and implementation tracking

* Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



* 20-40 hours per week

* Initial 90-day evaluation period

* Compensation and responsibility review following successful completion of the evaluation period

* Long-term growth opportunity based on performance, accuracy, reliability, and judgment



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow all instructions will not be considered.



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction.

3. Complete written responses to the questions below.

4. The words “VLARI Case Coordinator” as the first line of your application.



Your video may be submitted using Loom, Google Drive, an unlisted YouTube video, or another accessible video-link service. Confirm that anyone with the link can view it.



IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE ADDRESS:



* Your name and current location

* Your most relevant professional experience

* The types of U.S. clients or companies you have supported

* Your experience with accounting, bookkeeping, client onboarding, insurance, or case management

* Why you are comfortable performing both administrative and analytical work

* How you communicate with a client who has not submitted required information

* Why you are interested in a long-term position



Please speak naturally. Do not simply read your résumé. Video-production quality is not important. We are evaluating your communication, professionalism, thought process, and ability to interact comfortably with clients.



WRITTEN APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Describe a situation in which you discovered missing or inaccurate information in a client file. What did you do?



2. How do you organize multiple clients, tasks, and deadlines?



3. What accounting, bookkeeping, CRM, project-management, and document-management systems have you used?



4. Describe your experience collecting information or documents from clients.



5. Are you comfortable making and receiving professional client calls? Please describe your experience.



6. How would you follow up with a client who has not responded to two document requests?



7. What would you do if a client asked you a technical question that you were not trained or authorized to answer?



8. Are you comfortable performing scheduling, email follow-up, data entry, file organization, and other administrative tasks while learning more advanced responsibilities?



9. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, describe your current schedule and availability.



10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



11. Please provide two professional references.



SELECTION PROCESS



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



* Attend a video interview

* Complete a short paid assessment using fictional client information

* Draft a sample client email

* Review a sample file for missing information

* Prepare a brief internal case summary

* Participate in a mock client call

mbers

title: SEO Outreach & Link Building Specialist — Acquire Online Communities
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE LINK BUILDING OUTREACH, THIS IS YOUR JOB — JUST A BIGGER PRIZE

You already know the loop: prospect sites in Ahrefs, check the traffic and niche, find the owner, reach out cold, negotiate a price, close the placement. We do the exact same thing — except instead of buying a guest post or a backlink, you're acquiring the whole community. Same skills, same tools, higher-value deals.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities in the wedding and lifestyle space. We're hiring an experienced SEO outreach / link builder to source and acquire communities for us. You bring the Ahrefs judgment and the outreach muscle; we'll teach you the platform side (Reddit) fast.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Prospect and vet communities from a list our software pulls — the same way you'd vet a site for a link: traffic, niche relevance, keyword and search intent, real engagement vs. inflated numbers

• Judge commercial value — does this niche have buyer-intent keywords and monetization potential, or does it just look big?

• Find the owner/moderator and reach out across the right channels (their public socials, DMs) — cold outreach you've done a thousand times

• Negotiate the price and close the acquisition — moderation rights or full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are set

• Keep a clean pipeline: prospects, outreach status, deals, spend



WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY HIRING FOR

1. Ahrefs-level judgment. Anyone can read a traffic number. You can look at a site or community and tell whether the niche is worth paying for — search intent, commercial keywords, traffic quality. This is the rare skill, and it's the one link builders already have.

2. Outreach and negotiation. Cold-contacting an owner, getting a reply, agreeing on a price, and closing. If you've negotiated guest post or link placements, you've done this — we just need you comfortable doing it on bigger deals.



Reddit experience is a plus, not a requirement. The platform mechanics are quick to learn for someone who already knows SEO.



WHO YOU PROBABLY ARE

• An experienced link builder, SEO outreach specialist, guest post / blogger outreach VA, or digital PR outreach person with real past work you can point to

• Fluent in Ahrefs (or Semrush) — prospecting, traffic analysis, keyword and niche evaluation

• Comfortable with high-volume cold outreach AND with negotiating a price with a site owner

• You understand niches, search intent, and what makes traffic actually valuable

• Organized, self-directed, runs your own pipeline

• Clear written English

• Bonus: affiliate marketing experience, or you've bought/sold websites or domains



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every acquisition you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Describe your link building / outreach experience — what kinds of sites did you prospect, what tools did you use, and roughly what volume of outreach and placements did you handle?

2. You're evaluating a site or community in Ahrefs. Beyond the raw traffic number, what specifically tells you the niche is genuinely valuable and worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. Tell me about a placement or deal where the owner wasn't interested at first. How did you get them to a yes, and how did you handle the price?

4. Your desired rate and weekly availability.

title: Acquisitions Specialist – Real Estate Acquisition Deal Making Experience Welcome
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS, WHOLESALING, OR DEAL-CLOSING — READ THIS

This is the same work you already do, just a different asset. If you've sourced off-market properties, cold-called owners who weren't listed, negotiated a price, and closed the transfer — you have exactly the skill set we need. Swap "distressed property" for "online community" and the job is identical: find the owner, figure out what it's worth, reach out, and close.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities. We're hiring a sharp closer to acquire them for us. The assets are Reddit communities — but we'll teach you the platform mechanics. What we can't teach is deal instinct and judgment, and that's what we're actually hiring for.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Start from a list of candidate communities our software pulls for you, and d
 which are worth going after

• Size up each one's real worth — the right niche, genuine demand, real commercial upside — not just the headline numbers

• Track down the owner and reach them across the right channels (often their public social profiles) to open a conversation

• Negotiate and close the deal — either moderation rights or a full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are agreed

• Keep a tidy pipeline of targets, conversations, deals, and spend



WHAT MATTERS MOST (in this order)

1. Judgment — anyone can read a traffic stat. The rare skill is knowing whether a community is actually worth paying for, and how much, without us in the room for every call.

2. Closing — cold-reaching a stranger, warming them up, negotiating, and getting the deal done. This is the bulk of the work.



Reddit experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — the platform side is quick to pick up. If you're a strong closer who's never touched Reddit, still apply.



WHO YOU LIKELY ARE

• A real estate acquisitions / disposition VA, wholesaler, cold caller, domain or website flipper, or anyone who sources and closes deals for a living

• You can size up an asset's value fast and be right

• You're comfortable reaching out to strangers and closing them

• You run your own pipeline with little oversight

• Clear written English

• Nice-to-have: Reddit, affiliate, or SEO background



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every deal you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Walk me through one deal you sourced and closed yourself — a property, domain, website, whatever. How'd you find it, how'd you d
 what it was worth, and how'd you close it?

2. When you size up an online asset, what actually tells you it's worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. You need to acquire something from an owner who isn't trying to sell. How do you reach them and open the negotiation?

4. Your desired rate or salary.

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a high organised and detail-oriented Bid Coordinator to support the preparation and submission of tenders and commercial bids for our business.

The role will involve coordinating the bid process from receipt of a tender through to final submission. You will be responsible for managing tender documentation, completing administrative requirements, coordinating information from different departments and ensuring that all submissions are accurate, complete and delivered on time.

You will work closely with our technical, commercial, finance and project teams, to gather the information required for each bid.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage and coordinate tender and bid submissions from initial receipt through to final submission.

• Review tender documents and identify submission requirements, deadlines, forms and supporting documentation.

• Maintain a clear bid tracker and tender pipeline, ensuring all deadlines and actions are monitored.

• Complete and coordinate administrative and pre-qualification documentation, including company information, questionnaires, declarations, certificates and compliance documents.

• Coordinate with relevant personnel within the business to obtain technical information, specifications, supplier quotations, costs and commercial information required for each tender.

• Work with the commercial and management teams to coordinate pricing and ensure all required commercial information is included.

• Prepare tender response documents and ensure that all required sections are completed correctly.

• Check submissions for accuracy, consistency and completeness before submission.

• Maintain organised records of submitted bids, supporting documents, quotations and correspondence.

• Ensure all bids are submitted within the required deadline and in accordance with the clients specified format and instructions.

• Follow up internally on outstanding information and actions to keep bids progressing.

• Support general business development and tender administrative activities as required.



Skills & Experience

• Previous experience in bid administration, tender coordination, sales administration, procurement, project administration or a similar role.

• Excellent organisational and time management skills

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately to tight deadlines.

• Confident communicating with different teams and following up on outstanding information.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.

• Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines at the same time.

• Comfortable working with detailed documentation and following tender instructions.

• Commercial awareness and an ability to understand basic pricing and quotation information.

• Able to work independently while also coordinating effectively with a wider team.



The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be someone who is highly organised, proactive and commercially aware, with a

strong eye for detail. You should be comfortable taking ownership of a tender once it is received, identifying

what is required, coordinating the relevant people and making sure nothing is missed before the submission

deadline.

The key requirement is the ability to coordinate the process, obtain the right information from the right

people and keep the bid moving towards a successful, on-time submission.

title: New Zealand focused Traffic Management Planner | Morning Shift
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and safety-focused Traffic Management Planner to support the development and documentation of robust traffic management strategies for civil and infrastructure projects. 



This role is responsible for bridging the gap between permanent engineering designs and temporary site safety, ensuring all Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) are meticulously prepared, risk-assessed, and compliant with relevant industry safety standards.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation

Compliance Management

Technical Software Utilisation 

Use specialised traffic management and CAD-based software to produce accurate traffic routing plans, site layouts, and operational diagrams. 



Stakeholder Collaboration

Requirements 

Proven experience in Traffic Management Planning, TMP design, civil roading, traffic engineering, construction planning, or a related field. 

At least 1 year of hands-on TMP design experience in New Zealand. 

Strong understanding of risk management frameworks, including hazard identification, 5x5 risk matrices, and residual risk evaluation. 

Strong familiarity with ISO principles or structured health and safety management systems. 

Ability to apply permanent road design principles within temporary traffic management environments. 

Strong computer literacy with the ability to quickly learn specialised technical planning software. 

High attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate, audit-ready technical documentation. 

Strong written and verbal English communication skills aligned with Australian professional standards. 

Experience with CAD or AutoCAD is highly advantageous, though not essential. 



Software Proficiency 

Traffic Management Software: Rapid Plan or equivalent CAD-based traffic management platforms

Education

Time Zone: New Zealand Business Hours

title: Product Researcher | Funnelish Dropshipping
description:
Product Researcher

E-commerce - Meta Ads - Dropshipping & Branded Funnels



About Us



If you've found winning products for European e-commerce markets and you're tired of working with teams that don't move fast - this is for you.



We run a fast-growing e-commerce group with multiple dropshipping and branded funnels across Norway, Germany, Sweden, and Israel. Our products span health supplements, beauty products, gadgets, and home goods - and we scale aggressively through paid Meta ads, high-volume creative testing, and data-driven decision making.



Our team includes media buyers, funnel builders, video editors, and customer support. We manage significant monthly ad spend across five active storefronts. Now we're hiring a Product Researcher to own and systematise everything related to finding our next winners.



The Role



You own the product pipeline. You don't launch ads or build funnels. Your job is to find products that have real potential, and filter out the ones that are already dead before we touch them.



You will work directly with the CEO and product manager with one goal: find scalable products before they peak.



What You'll Do

- Research winning products across EU and global markets using ad libraries and spytools

- Do deep keyword-based research in the Meta Ad Library to surface early-mover opportunities

- Cross-reference findings across multiple tools (Afterlib and similar) to validate signals

- Validate demand using ad engagement signals - reach, likes, comments, share velocity, run duration

- Read product lifecycle curves and flag saturation early

- Assess whether a product is viable at our CPAs before recommending it

- Deliver structured product research reports with a clear go/no-go verdict and reasoning

- Track tested products over time and build pattern recognition across categories

- Ensure strong alignment between product picks and what actually converts on Meta



What You Bring

- 3+ years of hands-on experience as a product researcher in the Funnelish/Shopify dropshipping space

- Deep knowledge about why a product would work or not

- Deep knowledge of the Meta Ad Library - keyword research, engagement reading, trend spotting

- Experience with spytools like Afterlib or similar

- Early-mover instinct - you find products before they peak, not after

- Ability to spot saturation signals and explain why a product is past its window

- Strong understanding of margins and CPA viability, not just product appeal

- Fluent written and spoken English

- High attention to detail and a structured, systematic way of thinking

- Ownership mentality - you spot opportunities early and act without hand-holding



How We Work - and What You Get

- Part-time start with a clear path to full-time for top performers

- $5-6/hour depending on experience

- Performance bonuses on top

- Direct collaboration with the CEO and product manager - no layers, fast feedback

- Access to proven funnels, live ad accounts, SOPs, and real ad spend from day one

- Approved expense reimbursement where applicable



How to Apply



Put your favourite animal in the subject line. This helps us spot detail-oriented applicants.



Please include:

- Your CV or resume

- Examples of products or niches you've researched (screenshots or Looms are fine)

- A short paragraph on how you approach identifying a winning product before it peaks

- Your weekly availability



Do not use AI to write your application. We test this during the assessment and will disqualify candidates who do.



We look forward to seeing what you've found.

title: Senior E-commerce Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online)
description:
About Sugardoh



Sugardoh is a U.S. consumer products company selling through Shopify, Amazon, and retail channels. We manage physical inventory, marketplace settlements, vendor bills, credit cards, payment processors, and multiple cash accounts.



We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper who can own our 2026 QuickBooks Online bookkeeping, produce a reliable monthly close, and communicate clearly when information is missing. This is a hands-on bookkeeping role. Our outside accounting firm handles tax returns, tax notices, state registrations, compliance matters, and communication with tax authorities.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Categorize and reconcile bank and card transactions in QuickBooks Online.

- Reconcile Amazon and Shopify sales, fees, refunds, reserves, and deposits, including A2X entries.

- Review BILL transactions, identify missing documents or duplicates, and prepare bills for internal approval.

- Reconcile payment processors, loans, accounts payable, inventory, and balance-sheet accounts.

- Maintain inventory and COGS schedules using information from operations, Amazon FBA, and fulfillment partners.

- Maintain approved recurring entries and schedules for accruals, prepayments, and loans.

- Update cleared cash and confirmed commitments in our weekly Google Sheets cash-flow forecast.

- Complete month-end close and deliver the P&L, balance sheet, cash-flow statement, reconciliation package, and open-items list.

- Maintain a clarification list stating the issue, proposed treatment, information needed, and responsible person.

- Document recurring processes.



THIS ROLE WILL NOT

- Approve or release payments.

- Transfer money or change bank or vendor payment information.

- Prepare tax returns, respond to tax notices, or contact tax authorities.

- Make tax, legal, or major accounting-policy decisions.

- Change Profit First allocations or management forecast assumptions.

- Complete the 2025 books; our accounting firm is handling that work.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- 3+ years using QuickBooks Online for U.S. businesses.

- Strong bank, credit-card, payment-processor, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

- Experience with an inventory-based e-commerce or consumer-products company.

- Understanding of Amazon and Shopify payout reports.

- Strong Google Sheets skills.

- Clear written English and a habit of asking questions instead of making unsupported entries.

- Reliable internet plus a backup connection.

- At least two hours of Central Time overlap on Monday or Tuesday.



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE

A2X, BILL, QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification, Amazon FBA, CPG, wholesale or multi-location inventory, cash-flow forecasting, and Profit First.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Long-term independent-contractor role.

- Approximately 15-20 hours per week after stabilization.

- Mostly asynchronous work.

- $8-$12 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- We expect to begin with a paid diagnostic. Any 2026 catch-up work will be separately scoped and capped before recurring work begins.

- Finalists will complete a short paid assessment.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line: SUG QBO - your first name



Please answer these five questions concisely:

1. How many years have you used QuickBooks Online for U.S. clients, and how many of those clients sold physical products?

2. Give one brief example of an inventory-based Amazon, Shopify, or consumer-products client and describe what you personally owned.

3. An Amazon bank deposit is lower than gross sales. What would you review before reconciling it?

4. Which of these have you used directly: A2X, BILL, Amazon reports, Shopify reports, inventory systems, or cash-flow forecasts? What did you do in each?

5. State your hourly rate, weekly availability, Central Time overlap, earliest start date, and primary internet plus backup connection.

title: Hospitality Interior Designer
description:
The Arbor Collection is seeking a highly organized, creative, and execution-focused Hospitality Interior Designer & Procurement Coordinator to support the design, furnishing, and improvement of our growing portfolio of distinctive short-term rentals and boutique hospitality properties.



This is a remote design and purchasing role—not a construction or project-management position. The ideal candidate can develop memorable design concepts, translate those concepts into detailed specifications, source the necessary products, and manage purchasing and delivery information with exceptional accuracy.



## Key Responsibilities



### Interior Design



* Develop cohesive design concepts for short-term rentals, luxury homes, and boutique hospitality spaces.

* Create mood boards, color palettes, furniture layouts, finish schedules, and room-by-room design specifications.

* Select furniture, lighting, flooring, paint colors, cabinetry, tile, wall treatments, paneling, artwork, accessories, and décor.

* Design distinctive, photographable spaces that improve the guest experience and strengthen listing performance.

* Help develop themed spaces and memorable amenities, including game rooms, theaters, lounges, saunas, and outdoor entertainment areas.

* Balance visual impact with durability, functionality, maintenance requirements, budget, availability, and lead times.

* Prepare clear design presentations for ownership review and approval.

* Revise designs based on ownership feedback, budget requirements, measurements, and site limitations.

* Maintain visual consistency while giving each Arbor Collection property its own identity.



### Product Sourcing and Procurement



* Research and source furniture, fixtures, equipment, décor, finishes, and operating supplies.

* Identify affordable, attractive, durable, and commercially practical product options.

* Compare vendors based on pricing, quality, reviews, availability, shipping costs, and estimated delivery dates.

* Prepare organized purchasing lists containing product links, images, dimensions, quantities, colors, prices, and lead times.

* Verify product specifications against measurements provided by the local team before ordering.

* Place approved orders and maintain complete purchasing records.

* Track orders, deliveries, backorders, cancellations, damages, returns, refunds, and replacements.

* Follow up with vendors to resolve purchasing and shipping issues.

* Maintain current furnishing, finish, and supply budgets.

* Develop a reliable database of preferred products, vendors, finishes, and replacement items.

* Identify opportunities to standardize frequently used furnishings, finishes, and supplies across the portfolio.



### Design Coordination



* Provide the local team with clear product information, finish selections, installation references, and design specifications.

* Organize design files so ownership, contractors, and on-site team members can easily understand what has been selected.

* Collaborate remotely with ownership, the local project manager, contractors, installers, photographers, and other team members.

* Review photographs and videos provided by the local team to help assess design progress and recommend adjustments.

* Prepare styling and staging instructions for the on-site team.

* Help create final room checklists so furnishings, décor, and accessories are installed as intended.

* Organize selections, receipts, warranties, care instructions, and replacement information for each property.

* Communicate product delays, budget concerns, design conflicts, and purchasing problems promptly.



## Role Boundaries



This position does not include on-site construction or project management, will not be responsible for:



* Supervising contractors or tradespeople

* Managing construction schedules

* Visiting or inspecting job sites

* Verifying the quality of construction work

* Taking field measurements

* Managing cleaners, maintenance technicians, or installers

* Enforcing contractor deadlines or performance

* Completing construction walkthroughs or punch lists

* Making unapproved structural, construction, or budget decisions

* Micromanaging the on-site execution of projects



The local project manager or designated on-site team member will be responsible for measurements, site conditions, contractor coordination, construction progress, installation, quality control, and final guest-readiness. This role supports that work by providing organized designs, specifications, purchasing information, and remote design guidance.



## Additional Responsibilities



* Research current hospitality and interior-design trends, materials, products, and creative techniques.

* Recommend property improvements that could strengthen guest experience, listing photography, and revenue potential.

* Help refresh existing rooms without requiring complete renovations.

* Source replacement items that closely match existing designs.

* Assist with design-related marketing materials, property presentations, and visual reference documents when needed.

* Maintain organized digital folders for each property and room.

* Help improve and document The Arbor Collection’s design and procurement systems.



## What We’re Looking For



* Experience in interior design, hospitality design, furniture sourcing, procurement, home staging, or a closely related field.

* Strong aesthetic judgment and the ability to design across several styles.

* Experience creating professional mood boards, furniture plans, and room specifications.

* Knowledge of attractive, affordable, functional, and durable furniture systems and finishes.

* Strong online research and product-sourcing abilities.

* Excellent organization, communication, documentation, and follow-through.

* Exceptional attention to dimensions, quantities, product specifications, pricing, and delivery details.

* Ability to manage multiple room designs and purchasing lists simultaneously.

* Sound independent judgment and an understanding of when ownership approval is required.

* Comfortable receiving direct feedback and revising designs accordingly.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

* Familiarity with short-term rentals, boutique hotels, or residential renovations is strongly preferred.

* Proficiency with Canva and design software is required; familiarity with tools such as SketchUp, AutoCAD, Revit, or similar platforms is preferred.

* Experience using project-management, spreadsheet, and purchasing-tracking tools is preferred.

* Strong written and spoken English is required.



A degree or professional credential in interior design is preferred but not required if the candidate has a strong portfolio and relevant professional experience.



## The Ideal Person



You are creative, resourceful, organized, and highly attentive to detail. You notice the proportions of a room, the quality of a finish, the practicality of a furniture selection,

title: Medical Coordinator — Appointment & Transportation Scheduling
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Medical Coordinator — Appointment & Transportation Scheduling



Position Summary



The Medical Coordinator organizes medical appointments, schedules transportation, verifies insurance information, requests medical documents, and coordinates communication among families, guardians, service coordinators, healthcare providers, and agency staff. This position ensures appointments are properly prepared for, records are obtained, and follow-up needs are tracked through completion.



Key Responsibilities



Medical Appointment Scheduling



Schedule and confirm primary care, specialist, dental, vision, therapy, laboratory, and follow-up appointments.

Maintain an accurate appointment calendar and communicate upcoming visits and schedule changes to the appropriate parties.

Coordinate referrals and track outstanding appointments, testing, and follow-up needs.

Obtain appointment preparation instructions and communicate them to nursing and direct care staff.

Ensure required paperwork, insurance information, and identification are available before each appointment.

Reschedule missed or canceled appointments promptly and report barriers to care.



Transportation Scheduling



Arrange transportation to and from medical appointments.

Confirm pickup times, locations, driver availability, and return-trip arrangements.

Coordinate wheelchair-accessible transportation and staff escorts when needed.

Provide drivers and accompanying staff with necessary appointment details.

Address transportation delays or cancellations and coordinate alternate arrangements.



Insurance Coordination



Verify insurance eligibility and maintain current Medicare, Medicaid, and other insurance information.

Confirm that medical providers accept the individual’s insurance.

Communicate with medical offices and insurance plans regarding referrals, prior authorizations, and transportation benefits.

Track coverage concerns and authorization delays, and report unresolved issues to management.

Maintain current copies of insurance cards in the appropriate records.



Communication and Care Coordination



Communicate professionally with individuals, families, guardians, service coordinators, doctors, nurses, transportation providers, and agency staff.

Notify appropriate parties of appointment dates, preparation requirements, schedule changes, and follow-up needs.

Coordinate the availability of guardians or other authorized representatives when needed for consent.

Forward provider recommendations, medical orders, and concerns to nursing or other designated personnel for review and action.

Coordinate follow-up appointments after emergency room visits and hospital discharges.

Provide management with updates regarding missed appointments, outstanding documents, and unresolved coordination concerns.



Medical Records and Document Requests



Obtain appointment documents, including visit summaries, consultation notes, test results, and discharge paperwork.

Request missing documents from medical offices, hospitals, laboratories, and other healthcare providers when they are not received after an appointment.

Maintain a tracking log of outstanding document requests and follow up until completed.

Use the agency’s online fax system to securely send and receive medical records, referrals, forms, and other required documents.

Monitor incoming faxes and route documents to the appropriate staff.

Confirm successful transmission of outgoing faxes and follow up on unsuccessful transmissions.

Save received documents to the correct individual’s record and forward them to nursing or other designated staff for review.

Protect confidential information and follow agency privacy, authorization, and recordkeeping procedures.



Documentation and Organization



Maintain accurate appointment, transportation, insurance, and communication records.

Prepare appointment packets using current information supplied by the appropriate staff.

Track referrals, authorizations, requested records, and follow-up tasks through completion.

Provide regular reports on completed appointments, upcoming visits, missed appointments, and outstanding items.



Qualifications



High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in healthcare administration or a related field preferred.

Experience in medical scheduling, healthcare coordination, medical office administration, or a related role preferred.

Working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, insurance verification, referrals, and prior authorizations.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple appointments and competing priorities.

Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills.

Proficiency with
, electronic calendars, spreadsheets, online fax systems, and electronic documentation.

Ability to work independently, resolve scheduling issues, maintain confidentiality, and consistently follow through.

Experience supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, including HCS or TxHmL services, preferred.



Scope of Position



This is an administrative coordination role. Clinical assessments, medical advice, interpretation of test results, and treatment decisions must be directed to licensed healthcare professionals.

title: Operations & Systems Manager (Amazon Agency, ClickUp + Automations)
description:
We are a leading Amazon advertising and brand-growth agency in California. We run the

Amazon channel for 25 consumer brands as their fractional Amazon COO: ads, listings,

creative, catalog, inventory and strategy. The team is small, senior and fully remote.



We do not have an operations problem because people are lazy. We have one because

nobody owns the rails. Tasks live in four places, SOPs exist for some things and not

others, and two founders still spend their week asking "did anyone do this?" You would

own the answer to that question.



This is not a task-chasing job and it is not a project manager job. You are the person

who d
 how the work is tracked, writes the procedure, and catches the problem

before the client does.



What you own



- ClickUp as the single source of truth. One standard space skeleton per client,

  statuses, owners, dependencies, recurring work, dashboards a founder can read in

  thirty seconds.

- SOPs. You write them, you get them followed, you fix them when reality changes.

  Authoring, not only following.

- A quality gate. Deliverables get checked against a standard before a client sees them.

- Onboarding runbooks for new clients and new team members.

- Risk surfacing. Deadlines, blockers and quiet accounts reach the founders before the

  client raises them.

- Upkeep of the automations we already run: Make scenarios, Missive routing, reporting

  pipelines, the connections between ClickUp, Google Drive, GoHighLevel and Stripe.



Your first 30 days are measured on broken things repaired, not new architecture. We

have a Make scenario that has never completed a single run, a Missive inbox that needs

a triage rule, and client spaces that have drifted apart. Fix those first. Nothing new

until something old works.



By day 60: an onboarding runbook exists and has been used on a live client. The quality

gate has caught at least one thing before it reached a client. A weekly operations

report reaches the founders without anyone asking for it.



By day 90: we stop asking "did anyone do X?"



What you need



- Real operations or delivery experience at an agency or a service business, not a

  coordinator role.

- ClickUp at administrator depth. Spaces, custom fields, task types, automations,

  dashboards. You will be asked to show this on a screen share.

- SOP authoring. Bring one you wrote that somebody else followed.

- Evidence you fixed a system you inherited broken. Building something clean from

  scratch is easier and is not what this job is.

- Comfort with Make, Zapier or equivalent. You do not have to be an engineer. You have

  to be able to open a broken scenario and work out why it stopped.

- Written English strong enough to write a procedure another person can follow without

  asking you a question.

- Daily working use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT. Tell us what you use them for.



Not required: deep Amazon knowledge, client-facing seniority, advertising experience.



Hours: flexible, with some overlap with Pacific time. We do not need you awake at 3 AM.



Tools: ClickUp, Missive, Make, Google Workspace, Slack, GoHighLevel, Fireflies, Claude.

Read-only access to Gusto and Stripe.



How to apply



Start your application with the words FIX THE RAILS. Applications without it are not read.



1. Your resume or LinkedIn.

2. One ClickUp setup you built or rebuilt. A screen recording of the real thing beats a

   description. Tell us what was wrong before you touched it.

title: Technical Executive Assistant (QA & Coordination)
description:
Company: Happy To Deliver

Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Business Hours

Starting Rate: $350/month





About the Role



Happy To Deliver is looking for a technically capable Executive Assistant to work closely with our Project Manager and support communication between management and our development teams.



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position. While the role includes administrative responsibilities such as inbox management, scheduling, documentation, and follow-ups, a significant part of the job involves working with software, testing changes, investigating issues, and communicating technical information.



You will help keep projects moving by making sure requests are documented, developers have the information they need, completed work is properly checked, and management has a clear understanding of progress and potential issues.



You do not need to be a senior developer. However, you should be comfortable around code, software applications, browser developer tools, and AI tools such as Claude.



Important: This position follows fixed U.S. business hours. Applicants in the Philippines should be comfortable working a night-shift schedule.



Responsibilities

Work directly with the Project Manager and provide regular updates on project progress, blockers, pending requests, and items requiring decisions.

Monitor and organize the Project Manager's inbox, respond to routine correspondence, and flag important messages.

Maintain visibility across active projects and development work.

Communicate requests, instructions, announcements, and updates between management and team members.

Track tasks and open requests through completion and follow up when work becomes delayed or stalled.

Test recently completed development work and verify that features behave as expected.

Identify, reproduce, and clearly document software issues or unexpected behavior.

Provide developers with detailed information needed to investigate and resolve reported issues.

Make small, well-defined changes to applications or codebases when appropriate.

Use AI tools such as Claude to assist with technical investigation, documentation, coding, troubleshooting, and day-to-day work.

Create clear written documentation and screen recordings when necessary.

Assist with scheduling, meeting notes, documentation, follow-ups, and other executive support responsibilities.

What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is organized and technically curious.



You should be able to open an unfamiliar project or repository, investigate what's happening, and explain your findings in straightforward language.



You should also be comfortable testing software methodically. If something doesn't work, we expect you to be able to reproduce the problem, document exactly what happened, and provide enough information for a developer to investigate it.



Required qualifications include:



Strong written and spoken English

Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable AI tools as part of your regular workflow

Basic knowledge of at least one programming language, preferably JavaScript, PHP, or Python

Previous experience with QA, software testing, technical support, development, or a similar technical role

Strong organizational and task-management skills

Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple requests without losing track of outstanding items

Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Reliable communication during working hours

Willingness and ability to work fixed U.S. business hours from the Philippines

Preferred Qualifications



Experience with any of the following is an advantage but is not required:



Browser Developer Tools, particularly Console and Network

Git and GitHub

Loom or similar screen-recording software

Project-management platforms

Bug/issue tracking systems

Remote development teams

Executive or administrative support

Working with teams distributed across multiple time zones

Compensation & Paid Trial



The position will begin with a paid trial period at [starting rate].



The trial period allows us to evaluate actual work quality, reliability, communication, technical judgment, problem-solving ability, and ability to operate independently.



Candidates who demonstrate that they can consistently perform the role to a high standard will have their compensation reviewed, with the opportunity for the rate to increase up to $700/month.



Compensation: The starting salary for this position is $350/month during the paid trial period. Upon successful completion of the trial period and confirmation in the role, the salary will increase to $700/month. All work completed during the trial period is paid.



All work performed during the trial period will be paid at the agreed starting rate.



How to Apply



Please
 your CV to 
 with the subject:



Technical Executive Assistant — [Your Name]



Along with your CV, provide brief answers to the following questions. A few sentences for each is enough. We're more interested in how clearly you think and communicate than in lengthy answers.



1. Describe an issue or defect you found in software. How did you notice it, how did you document it, and how did you explain it to the person who resolved it?



2. Describe the most recent change you made to a codebase or application. What did you change, and how did you confirm that it worked?



3. How do you use Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI tools in your daily work? Give one specific recent example.



4. Describe a time you had to explain something technical to a non-technical person. How did you make sure they understood it?

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief interview before beginning the paid trial period.

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator (CRM & Paid Media)
description:
Our Story

GBC Wellness is a New Zealand-based, multi-brand health and wellness group. We own and operate four brands, spanning B2B wholesale distribution and B2C premium natural supplements and performance nutrition, sold across NZ, Australia, the UK and Europe. We're a small, fast-moving marketing team and we're looking for someone who wants to own real execution, not just tick boxes.



The Role

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join our team remotely, owning
/CRM execution and paid media management across our four wellness brands.



This role sits at the centre of our day-to-day marketing output.
/CRM and paid media execution are the two most important parts of the job, they are what keeps revenue moving between bigger campaign moments, so strong hands-on experience in both is essential, not a stretch goal.



Key Responsibilities

1.
 & Lifecycle Marketing (CRM) — the core of this role

• Build, schedule, QA and send EDM campaigns across all brands in Klaviyo, including bundle launches, promotions, price-change communications and seasonal sends

• Build, test and continually optimise automated flows: welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment and sunset/win-back

• Manage list segmentation and hygiene, and monitor deliverability, open, click and unsubscribe trends

• Support day-to-day Klaviyo administration (data imports/exports, list clean-up, template maintenance).



2. Paid Media Management & Execution — the second core pillar

• Build, launch and manage Meta 
/Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns across brands

• Set up and QA conversion tracking (Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversion actions) for new campaigns and landing pages

• Maintain audience and retargeting lists, manage negative keyword lists, and roll out new ad creative on brief

• Monitor day-to-day campaign performance and flag under-performing ads, audiences or keywords for review.



3. Campaign & Promotional Execution

• Execute bundle and promotional campaigns end-to-end against a brief and calendar, coordinating
, paid and on-site assets

• Work with design and copy resources to get campaign assets delivered on time

• Support seasonal, clearance and best-before-end (BBE) campaign rollouts.



4. Reporting

• Compile monthly performance reporting for
 and paid channels

• Contribute channel data into the monthly brand performance report.



5. Creator & Ambassador Support

• Coordinate content creator and ambassador logistics, briefs and content pipelines.



Key Skills & Experience

We're hiring at coordinator/junior level for this role. You don't need years of agency experience, you need to be hands-on with the tools below and comfortable learning fast in a small team.

• 3 years' experience in digital marketing, ecommerce or a CRM/email marketing role

• Working knowledge of Klaviyo or a similar ESP (Mailchimp, Omnisend); Klaviyo experience strongly preferred

• Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (campaign build and day-to-day management level)

• Comfortable managing multiple brands or projects concurrently, and following briefs closely

• Strong attention to detail and ability to QA your own work before it goes live

• Excellent written English (UK/NZ spelling and grammar a plus)

• Able to work core overlap hours with a New Zealand-based team.



Nice to Have

These aren't required to apply, but they'd let you take on more of the strategic side of the role over time:

• Experience owning lifecycle/CRM strategy and segmentation planning, not just executing to a calendar

• PPC strategy experience: keyword research, bid strategy and budget allocation, not just campaign build and monitoring

• Exposure to eCommerce trading calendars, revenue/conversion reporting, or CRO

• Experience with an ESP migration (e.g. HubSpot to Klaviyo or similar)

• Experience working across multiple brands or regions at once.

title: Video Editor for Youtube Faceless Channel
description:
YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Term

Role (Script, Voice-Over & Music Provided — No

French Required)

Quick note before you read further: this is a French-language YouTube channel, but you do NOT

need to speak, read, or write French to apply. We provide the complete script, a professional

voice-over, and the music for every video. Full details are in “What We Provide” and “Requirements”

below.

Compensation

We are looking for a partner who can combine production quality with a strong value-for-money ratio.

This is not a "low-cost" budget: we invest in polished, professional editing. We are keeping the budget

controlled today simply because the channel is still in its early growth phase — that's the honest situation

right now, not a reflection of how much we value the work.

We prefer a fixed monthly rate for a long-term collaboration.

To be transparent about how this can evolve: to the extent that the channel's growth comes from the quality of

the videos you deliver, we will revisit the compensation together — monthly or per-video — and increase it

accordingly. Your work has a direct impact on that growth, and it's important to us that this be reflected in

how you're paid over time.

Please include your expected monthly or per-video rate in your application (in USD or PHP).

Applicants seeking significantly higher compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to candidates

offering the best balance between work quality and rate.

Expected Workload

At least 3 long-form videos per week (a minimum of approximately 12 videos per month), around 30

minutes each. Workload may increase depending on channel needs. This is intended as a long-term, ongoing

role — not a one-off project.

About Us

We run a French-language, faceless YouTube channel focused on:

• Historical mysteries and archaeology

• Ancient civilizations

• Megaliths and unexplained discoveries

• Documentary-style storytelling

We are working to bring our channel to a more polished, immersive, and visually refined level than our

current content — while keeping a reasonable and responsible budget. We are looking for a genuine win-win

partnership, not the lowest rate on the market.

Important

This position is not for basic video editing. We are looking for an editor who can turn a script and voice-over

into a truly immersive documentary experience, combining visual research, footage sourcing, animation,

motion design, and pacing — with an excellent value-for-money ratio rather than a premium rate.

Strict deadline compliance and responsive communication are eliminatory criteria. An editor who is late

on deliveries or unreachable for several days will not be retained, regardless of the artistic quality of the edit.

What We Provide

• Complete script

• Voice-over recording (AI-generated, professional quality, in French)

• Background music (provided by us for each video)

• Reference video(s) to illustrate the expected style

• Clear written instructions and timing/pacing notes in English for every video

• Creative direction and feedback at every stage

Your Responsibilities

• Edit high-retention YouTube videos (long-form, around 30 minutes)

• Independently source all necessary visuals: stock footage, photos, maps, graphics, animations, AI-generated

images (good quality), and B-roll

• Add motion graphics, zooms, transitions, and visual storytelling elements

• Integrate the provided music and add sound effects suited to the documentary tone

• Follow the editing style of our reference videos

• Consistently deliver projects on the agreed schedule (ideally 48–72 hours per video, depending on

complexity) — any unannounced delay will be considered a serious issue

• Respond quickly to messages (within 24 hours max on weekdays) regarding progress, feedback, or any

project-related question, in English

• Revise videos based on feedback when necessary

Requirements

• Strong experience editing YouTube videos, ideally documentary, history, or storytelling content

• No French language skills required. We provide the complete script, professional voice-over, and music

for every video — your role is 100% visual and technical, not linguistic. You do not need to write, translate,

or speak French

• Excellent storytelling and pacing skills, with a good ear for rhythm and timing: you will be cutting to a

professional voice-over track, the same skill used to edit to music or any voice-over — even in a language

you don't speak

• Ability to keep viewers engaged throughout long-form content

• Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software (your choice of tool —

only the result matters)

• Ability to independently source visuals and assets

• Absolute reliability on deadlines and responsive communication in English (eliminatory criterion in case of

repeated failure)

• Attention to detail

• Stable internet connection for exchanging large files

• Ability to deliver a quality result within a reasonable production budget

Note on French: this channel targets a French-speaking audience, but the script, voice-over, and music

are already written, recorded, and composed for you. Basic French reading ability is a nice-to-have (it

can help when matching on-screen text to timing cues) but is absolutely not required. English is our

working language for all communication, feedback, and instructions.

Preferred Experience

Experience editing channels similar to:

• Uncharted Mysteries (
/channel/UCtrFDttZdb4QxBpQc3fi1Cg) — very close to our own niche

and target style: ancient civilizations, archaeology, and unexplained mysteries

• Fern

• Wendover Productions

• MagnatesMedia

• RealLifeLore

• Or French-language documentary channels such as Underscore_, Nota Bene, Passé Sauvage, Le Précepteur

— you don't need to understand French to study their pacing, structure, and visual style (feel free to mention

your own references)

Important Application Instructions

To confirm you have read this entire job posting:

1 Include the word MEGALITHE as the second line of your application.

2 Record a short 30–60 second Loom video (or equivalent) introducing yourself and explaining why you are a

good fit for this position. This video must be recorded in English.

3 Provide a short 50–60 second editing sample (existing, or made specifically for this application) in the style

of our reference channel, Uncharted Mysteries (
/channel/UCtrFDttZdb4QxBpQc3fi1Cg) —

showcasing your visual sourcing, pacing, motion design, and sound design.

4 Answer all application questions below.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will be automatically rejected.

Application Questions

1 Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited and explain your role in each project.

2 Which editing software do you use?

3 How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have?

4 Have you edited documentary, history, or storytelling channels before?

5 If I provide only a script, a voice-over, and background music, can you source all footage, images, maps,

and graphics yourself? Please explain your process.

6 What YouTube channels inspire your editing style?

7 How many 25–35 minute documentary videos can you realistically edit per month?

8 How many hours per week are available for this project?

9 What is your internet speed?

10 What monthly or per-video compensation are you seeking (USD or PHP)? Please provide a rate that reflects

a strong value-for-money balance, suited to a growing project.

11 Can you guarantee a 48–72 hour delivery turnaround per video and a response to our messages within 24

hours max? If not, please specify your actual availability.

12 Have you ever edited video or audio content in a language you don't speak or aren't fluent in? If yes, briefly

describe how you approached pacing and timing without understanding the words.

Final Selection Process

Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a roughly 2-minute sample edit using a script, voice-over

recording, music, and reference video that we provide.

The purpose of this test is to evaluate:

• Storytelling ability

• Editing style

• Visual sourcing skills

• Pacing and viewer retention

• Sound design (music integration + sound effects)

• Attention to detail

• Ability to follow instructions

• Respect of the test deadline (a direct indicator of future reliability)

Please do not apply if you are unwilling to complete the sample edit.

Due to the expected volume of applications, only candidates selected for the next stage will receive the

test materials.

Long-Term Opportunity

We are building a French-language YouTube channel with the ambition to grow in both quality and volume,

following a progressive growth strategy and a controlled budget. We are looking for a reliable editor to grow

with us long-term.

The channel is starting out today, but the video quality you deliver is one of the direct drivers of that growth

— better editing means better retention, and better retention means a channel (and a budget) that grows faster.

As it grows, so does what we can offer the editor behind it.

Strong performers will receive:

• Higher monthly or per-video compensation as the channel's growth and budget allow

• Performance bonuses

• Additional editing projects

• Opportunities to work across multiple future channels

If you are passionate about creating engaging documentary-style content, reliable on deadlines, responsive in

communication, and looking for a trust-based partnership with a strong value-for-money balance, we would

love to hear from you.

Note on language (please read): this is a French-language channel, but as explained above, you do

not need to speak, read, or write French. We provide the finished script, a professional voice-over, and

music for every video. English is our working language for all communication, feedback, and

instructions. What matters most is your editing skill: pacing, visual storytelling, and attention to detail

title: LAND BUILDER ACQUISITION AND QUALIFICATION VA
description:
LAND BUILDER ACQUISITION AND QUALIFICATION VA



We are looking for an experienced Real Estate VA who has previous experience communicating with home builders, land developers, or real estate acquisition professionals.



This is NOT a beginner position.



I am specifically looking for someone who already understands how to identify, contact, qualify, and build relationships with builders and developers who are actively acquiring vacant land.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your primary responsibility will be to identify builders and developers in our target markets, contact them, speak with the person responsible for land acquisition, and determine exactly what type of vacant land they are currently looking to purchase.



You will:



* Research active builders and land developers in specific markets

* Identify the decision maker responsible for land acquisition

* Call builders and developers directly

* Speak professionally with acquisition managers, owners, land managers, and developers

* Qualify builders based on their current land-buying activity

* Find out exactly what types of land they are looking for

* Obtain their specific land acquisition criteria and buy box

* Determine their preferred locations and counties

* Determine acreage requirements

* Determine desired number of lots

* Determine zoning requirements

* Determine utility requirements

* Determine price ranges and land budgets

* Determine whether they purchase raw land, entitled land, finished lots, or development sites

* Determine their preferred property characteristics

* Determine what makes them immediately reject a property

* Determine how frequently they are currently acquiring land

* Determine their acquisition timeline

* Identify their preferred method of receiving opportunities

* Maintain accurate records of every conversation

* Enter qualified buyers and their criteria into our CRM

* Follow up with qualified builders to keep their buying criteria current

* Build long-term relationships with active land buyers



The goal is NOT simply to build a list of builders.



The goal is to build a database of QUALIFIED, ACTIVE builders with specific and actionable buying criteria.



For example, we don’t want:



“ABC Homes buys land in Texas.”



We want:



“ABC Homes is actively looking for 5-15 acre residential development sites in X County, needs public water and sewer, prefers 20+ potential lots, budget is up to $1.5M, and is looking to acquire another site within the next 90 days.”



That is the level of information we are looking for.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have previous experience with one or more of the following:



* Calling home builders

* Calling land developers

* Builder acquisition

* Land acquisition

* Real estate acquisitions

* Real estate wholesaling

* Land wholesaling

* Land development

* Builder/developer prospecting

* Qualifying real estate buyers

* Speaking with acquisition managers or decision makers



You must be comfortable getting on the phone and having professional conversations with builders and developers.



I am NOT looking for someone with no experience who needs to be taught how to do this from scratch.



If you have never spoken with builders or developers before, this position is probably not a good fit.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate:



* Has proven real estate experience

* Has experience speaking with builders or developers

* Is comfortable making outbound calls

* Can speak confidently with business owners and acquisition managers

* Knows how to ask good qualifying questions

* Can dig deeper instead of accepting vague answers

* Understands the difference between a general buyer lead and a qualified buyer

* Is highly organized

* Has excellent English communication skills

* Can accurately document conversations

* Understands real estate terminology

* Can work independently

* Is comfortable using a CRM

* Is results-oriented



IMPORTANT



This position requires someone who can have an intelligent conversation with a builder and uncover their actual acquisition needs.



You should be able to ask follow-up questions such as:



“What are you actively looking to acquire right now?”



“What counties are you currently buying in?”



“What acreage are you looking for?”



“How many lots would you ideally like to get from a site?”



“What zoning do you require?”



“Are you buying raw land or only entitled/finished lots?”



“What utilities do you require?”



“What is your typical land budget?”



“What are the biggest reasons you would reject a property?”



“When are you looking to acquire your next property?”



“How many properties are you currently looking for?”



“Who is the decision maker for purchasing land?”



This is about understanding the builder’s BUSINESS and BUYING CRITERIA, not simply collecting contact information.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years of real estate experience do you have?

2. What experience do you have working with home builders or land developers?

3. Have you personally called builders or developers to discuss their land acquisition needs? Explain exactly what you did.

4. What type of builders or developers have you spoken with?

5. What questions would you ask a builder to determine their land-buying criteria?

6. Give me an example of a builder buy box you have previously qualified.

7. Have you worked in vacant land, residential real estate, or both?

8. What CRM systems have you used?

9. How many outbound calls were you typically making per day in your previous position?

10. Please explain why you are no longer working with your previous client/employer.

11. How long have you been working in real estate?

12. How long have you been doing builder/developer outreach?



Please include the word BUILDER at the beginning of your application so I know you read the entire posting.

title: Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator
description:
Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, responsive **Virtual Parts & Procurement Coordinator** to support our Parts and Supply Chain operations. This role serves as a key point of contact for parts customers while helping keep estimates, payments, Parts Research requests, purchase orders, and order updates moving forward.



You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day follow-through that creates a great customer experience and gives our internal Supply Chain team more time to focus on purchasing, sourcing, technical research, inventory, and complex procurement needs.



## What You’ll Do



* Answer inbound parts calls, emails, and assigned leads.

* Gather customer and equipment information, including make/model, serial numbers, data tags, photos, quantities, and requested parts.

* Create and maintain accurate customer and lead records.

* Coordinate requests requiring technical identification with our internal Parts Research team.

* Create and send parts estimates using approved information.

* Follow up consistently on open estimates through sale or closure.

* Communicate pricing, availability, and lead times to customers.

* Send payment links or instructions and follow up on routine outstanding payments.

* Create clear handoffs to Supply Chain when parts are ready to be ordered or shipped.

* Follow up on open purchase orders and vendor acknowledgments.

* Maintain accurate expected ship dates, lead times, backorder/delay information, and tracking details.

* Keep customers and internal teams informed throughout the process.

* Proactively flag delays, exceptions, or issues requiring additional support.



## What Success Looks Like



You are responsive, organized, and consistent. Customers receive timely communication, estimates don’t fall through the cracks, open orders have clear status updates, and internal teams can quickly determine where an order stands.



Key performance expectations include:



* **95%+** compliance with inbound customer response standards

* **98%+** compliance with required parts estimate follow-up

* **95%+** compliance with open purchase order visibility requirements



## What This Role Does Not Own

This role supports procurement and order coordination but does **not** independently make purchasing, sourcing, pricing, or technical parts-identification decisions. Complex vendor issues, inventory management, physical receiving/shipping, and other procurement exceptions remain with the internal Supply Chain team.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with customers by phone and email

* Consistent with follow-up and task management

* Able to manage multiple open requests without losing track of details

* Proactive about communicating delays and next steps

* Comfortable working across multiple systems and maintaining accurate records

* Team-oriented and able to coordinate effectively with Sales, Service, and Supply Chain

* Able to work consistently during **7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time**



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys customer service, coordination, organization, and keeping processes moving from initial request through completion.
